title: Robots dance, clean and rescue toy cats at expo in Japan | REUTERS
transcription: From demonstrating its rescue capabilities during disasters to busting a move and serving up drinks. The latest advances in humanoid robot technology are on full display at this year's International Robot Exhibition in Tokyo. The Kaleido 9 is using this toy cat to showcase how it could save people during a disaster. Yoshimoto Matsuda, managing executive officer of Kawasaki Heavy Industries, said the robot is meant to be deployed to disaster areas where access for humans is difficult. We aim to create robots that are robust and reliable for deployment in places where humans cannot work or where they need to work alongside robots. That's why we insist on human-sized robots, so existing equipment like fireproof suits and protective gear can be used without modification. Our vision is not about robots performing repetitive tasks in factories or improving precision, but about working on site, improvising, and using the same tools as humans. Kawasaki spent about a decade developing the robot, which is still in the testing phase. The bot showed off how it can be a lifesaver in other ways, including performing domestic duties like raking up leaves and throwing out the trash. Across the exhibition hall, a dance-off is taking place. This robot was manufactured by Chinese robotics developer Unitree, but programmed and calibrated by Japanese robotics company GMO. Tomohiro Uchida of GMO said the dance moves show just how far robotic development has come. About a year ago, humanoid robots were still very stiff and jerky. People couldn't imagine them functioning in real-world settings. But in the past six months, or even the last three months, the software has been rapidly updated. And now they can perform a variety of movements. So we wanted visitors to see what kind of movements are possible now. As part of that demonstration, we had it perform a dance. It appears to move quite fluidly now. Uchida added that he sees humanoid robots as a solution to help fill gaps in what he called a declining labor force in developed countries.

title: Why the Internet is MAD at the Sony a7 V
uploader: The VONG Opinion with Jason Vong
transcription: And for those of you with a full-time job and not perpetually online, the internet has been screaming how Canon, Nikon, Panasonic, Fujifilm and hell, even Apple is winning because they're allowing users to shoot in open gate, which means the camera is recording the entire sensor, usually a square or close to square format. So there will be enough room for us to use the footage in either horizontal or vertical orientation. Perfect for pros who have to deliver in both because advertising on phone screens have been increasingly popular and open gate saves us from doing double the work, shooting horizontally, then vertically, or doing that awkward vertical crop from a horizontal footage. God, this vertical crop is just too close. Bleh! I hate it. What's even worse is Canon and Nikon are starting to equip their mid-range cameras, the R6 Mark III and the ZR to shoot raw videos, which means users can change the ISO and white balance cleanly in the edit. Arguably very handy. But is it necessary? Now, Sony is choosing to have their gates closed, and I've expected that. No way the A7 Mark 5 would get open gate or even raw video for that matter. At least not before the next A7S or the next FX camera. You know what I mean? Keep in mind, this is a mid-range camera. It's not meant to have the newest cutting-edge features until its bigger brothers do. And raw video is nice, but what's not nice is the insane file size that comes with it. In order for us to manipulate the ISO and white balance in post cleanly, requires a lot of data. The new Canon R6 Mark II requires approximately 10 gigabytes per minute for a 7K 30p raw video. So if you want to shoot an hour's worth of footage, you're going to need a little more than 600 gigabytes of memory. Yikes. For the pros of pros, you guys might not mind it, but most people wouldn't need this much power, nor even have the resources to handle this much power. Would it have been nice to have? Absolutely. But Sony decided to hold back. They'll do it someday once they're pressured enough to do so, but for now, the A7 Mark 5 does not and will not have any form of open gate raw. title: ROG Xbox Ally Tutorial Video - First Time Setup
transcription:
Welcome to your new ROG Xbox Ally. Getting started couldn't be easier.

When you first boot the device, you'll be greeted with a streamlined Windows setup. Follow the prompts to connect to Wi-Fi, log into your Microsoft account, and set up the fingerprint sensor on the power button. After that, you'll be dropped into the new Xbox full-screen experience, which puts your games front and center. But, before you start browsing, you might want to update all of your software. We've already released a number of improvements for day one users. So tap the bell icon in the Xbox app and download any updates it finds. Once that's done, press the command center button on the left side of the device and tap open Armory Crate SE. Inside the update center, you'll find a number of new updates that will add new features, improve performance, and more. Note that one of these will be a BIOS update, which requires you to plug your Ally into a power outlet. Make sure not to turn off the device while it updates. Once you've got the latest software, you're ready to start gaming. From the new Xbox app, you can check out new games in the store or dive right in with Xbox Game Pass. The ROG Ally comes with three months free, so you can start playing right away. To browse your games, press the library button on the right side of the device. You can download games to play them locally on your device, stream them from the cloud with a Game Pass subscription, or remote play from your Xbox console. The new aggregated library shows not just your Xbox games, but games from battle.net and other leading storefronts as well. So you can install any game you own on PC and start playing. Pressing the Xbox button will show your most recent games as well as your other game launchers, so you can easily find and install more titles. You can navigate the game bar with the left and right bumpers. Moving to the left will show you the Armory Crate command center where you can quick toggle different hardware settings. Put your Ally in silent mode for better battery life or crank it up to turbo mode for maximum performance. Launching Armory Crate SE will give you even more hardware options to play with, from vibration intensity to joystick sensitivity and even gyro controls. You can also press and hold the command center button to go directly to the gaming co-pilot tab, which can give you game recommendations, provide strategies for those tough bosses, or fill you in on an NPC. Or you can long press the library button to quickly start a conversation with gaming co-pilot without ever leaving your game. Finally, at any time you can press and hold the Xbox button or swipe up on the bottom of the screen to open the task switcher. From here you can see your open apps, flip between them, or open the Windows desktop where you can do anything that's possible on a Windows PC. The simplicity of Xbox meets the power of Windows.

title: Breast Pump Tutorial for Beginners | Easy and Comfortable Pumping Guide
transcription: Today's video is all about how to use a breast pump correctly in a simple and comfortable way. Many new moms feel confused when they start pumping, so this guide will help you understand each step clearly. Using a breast pump is completely natural and extremely helpful for mothers who want to store milk for their baby or maintain their feeding routine. Start by checking all the parts of your pump to make sure everything is clean and ready. Before placing the pump, sit in a comfortable position so the process goes smoothly. Gently place the breast shield on your skin, making sure it sits in the center and fits properly. Before turning on the pump, take a deep breath and relax because pumping works best when your body is calm. Turn on the pump and begin with the lowest suction setting. Slowly increase the suction until you find the level that feels comfortable for you. It may take a little time for the milk to start flowing, and that is completely normal. If you want, you can look at your baby's picture or use a warm compress to help trigger your let down reflex faster. Once the milk starts collecting in the bottle, let the pump run naturally. A session usually lasts around 10 to 15 minutes, but you can continue longer if your body needs more time. When you are done, switch off the pump and gently remove the shield. Transfer the milk into a safe storage container and place it in the refrigerator or freezer right away. Don't forget to wash all the pump parts with warm water and mild soap. Keeping everything clean is very important for your baby's health. Breast pumping is a simple routine that becomes easier with practice. Stay consistent and you'll feel more confident every day. I hope this tutorial helps you. If you enjoyed the video, make sure to like and subscribe for more helpful content.

title: More than a dozen arrested during ICE protests in Chinatown
transcription:
Good evening, I'm Joe Torres. Tanya has the night off. We begin with more than a dozen people arrested during an anti-ICE demonstration in lower Manhattan. It all started on 209 Center Street in Chinatown this afternoon. According to the NYPD, protesters blocked streets and building exits. Eyewitness News reporter Anthony Carlo has the story.
[Crowd noises]
Crowds of protesters showed up looking to disrupt a convoy of federal immigration vehicles from parading through lower Manhattan. 
[Chanting: Ice out now!]
But they ended up in a standoff with the NYPD. 
[Woman yelling: Is your neighbor your enemy?]
Those cops were called to stop protesters from blocking federal agents exiting a garage on Center Street. The NYPD says when they did not disperse and some started throwing debris, its officers started making arrests, 15 of them. An action condemned tonight by the New York Immigration Coalition. 
There's a report right now that we're following up on of an older gentleman um and his daughter who were arrested, who had nothing to do with anything and were just walking. So this is a moment for all of us to ask the question of, does the NYPD protect New York City residents or is it going to continue to harm them through collaborating with Immigration and Customs Enforcement?
Sources tell Eyewitness News, the special agent in charge of Homeland Security's New York office called the police commissioner to apologize. Commissioner Tish telling him the show of force by ICE was, quote, unacceptable and put federal agents and her cops in harm's way.
[Chanting: ICE sucks, New York!]
Though agitators, according to Homeland Security, were summoned to the location by way of social media. When individuals broadcast the location of ICE, they are putting a target on the backs of officers. We are grateful for the NYPD officers that responded to these violent agitators.
The violence that occurred today could have been avoided had ICE agents not escalated tensions. It doesn't make any of us safer. And this has never been about safety and security with ICE and this federal administration. It's been about cruelty.
Canal Street and the surrounding area has been a hotbed for federal enforcement over the last month, putting the NYPD in a bit of a pickle. title: Thousands protest in Bulgaria ahead of final parliamentary vote on controversial new budget plan
transcription: A controversial new budget draft was withdrawn on Thursday morning after thousands of protesters took to the streets of Sofia to oppose it the night before. The government had proposed to increase social security contributions and double dividend taxes in an ambitious new budget, which would have set a new spending record at around 46% of GDP, as well as dramatically increased public debt. Wednesday evening's rally was organized by the opposition coalition and is estimated to have drawn around 20,000 people. Protesters gathered outside the National Assembly building, where lawmakers convened to examine the proposed budget. They formed a massive human chain around the parliament building in an effort to block all exits and prevent MPs from leaving the premises. Police say the protests, which were declared as peaceful, quickly escalated and turned violent, announcing that three police officers were injured. Authorities say some protesters threw firecrackers and glass bottles at deployed officers and attempted to overturn a police van. The protest came ahead of a final parliamentary vote to gain approval and just a few weeks before the Balkan nation is set to enter the Eurozone.

title: Fighting for Freedom in Hungary: Andrienn’s story
transcription: I'm Adriana Tuzu. I used to work as a criminal judge for 24 years and I resigned in last December. Judicial independence is not an easy thing to digest. I would say that there are still independent judges in Hungary, but the whole system is not independent anymore. Tens of thousands of Hungarians protested long into the night against the government's rewriting of the constitution. There are two main actors who are defining the position of judiciary. These are elected in order to influence the decisions of the Supreme Court in favor of the government. Nowadays, they can also overrule the decisions of the Court of the European Union. Now, Hungary is embroiled in a legal battle with the European Union. First of all, we should define what is European Union, Brussels. They should be our servant. If you want to be successful as a judge, you have to be loyal, otherwise you wouldn't get forward. And on the other hand, if you are not, if you speak up, you have to face difficulties. I quit judiciary after 28 years working at the same court, among the same people, and I missed this the most. It was a really hard decision to make. I was born to be a judge, and I really identified as one. Uh, as as a in my in my personal life, the fact that I had to leave, I still dream about it. A lot. Being a judge. title: The Bonelli’s Eagle filmed & photographed from a hide in Extramadura
transcription: The Bonelli's eagle in the wild landscapes of Extremadura, Spain. This impressive raptor is one of Europe's most iconic and most elusive birds of prey. The Bonelli's eagle is known for its powerful build, striking plumage, and remarkable agility in flight. With its pale underparts, bold dark patches on the wings, and intense gaze, it is unmistakable once seen up close. This species typically prefers rugged terrain, rocky hillsides, cliffs, Mediterranean forests, and open plains where it hunts with extraordinary precision. Its main prey includes rabbits, partridges, pigeons, and sometimes even other birds of prey. Bonelli's eagles are territorial and often form long-term pairs, returning to the same nesting sites year after year. Although once widespread, the species has declined in many parts of Europe due to habitat loss, disturbance, and reduced prey availability. Spain, and especially regions like Extremadura, now hosts some of the most important remaining populations. Conservation efforts in recent years have helped stabilize numbers, but the Bonelli's eagle remains a near-threatened species, deserving continued protection. Capturing this magnificent bird in its natural habitat is always special. I hope you enjoy these moments as much as I did while filming them.

title: G20 Summit 2025: Critical Minerals for Global Economic Growth and Resilience
transcription: The Global South's mineral wealth, a game changer for economic growth, but at what cost? The G20's 2025 Summit in Johannesburg, South Africa has ignited a crucial conversation about the role of critical minerals in shaping our future. But here's where it gets controversial. Can these resources truly drive inclusive growth and resilience, or will they perpetuate existing inequalities? In a bold move, the G20 has unveiled its critical minerals framework, aiming to transform these essential resources into catalysts for sustainable development. The plan? To empower mineral rich nations, particularly in the Global South, to move beyond simply exporting raw materials. And this is the part most people miss. The framework seeks to address the systemic challenges these countries face, from underinvestment and limited technology to socio-economic and environmental hurdles. As the world undergoes rapid economic transformations, think sustainable energy transitions, digitalization, and industrial innovation, the demand for critical minerals is skyrocketing. However, the G20 declaration highlights a stark reality. Many producer countries, especially developing nations, are struggling to capitalize on this opportunity. The framework offers a voluntary, non-binding road map to foster sustainable, transparent, and resilient mineral value chains. This includes boosting investment in exploration, promoting local processing, beneficiation, and strengthening governance for responsible mining practices. Here's the catch. While the framework promises to preserve the sovereign rights of mineral rich countries, it also raises questions about equitable benefit sharing and environmental stewardship. Will local communities truly reap the rewards or will multinational corporations dominate the landscape. The G20 encourages collaboration among governments, private sectors, investors, and local communities, but how will this play out in practice? Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of international cooperation in addressing global challenges from climate change to food systems. India's commitment to a human-centric, sustainable, and inclusive future aligns with the G20's vision. But as the summit concludes, one question lingers, can critical minerals truly become a force for broad-based development, or will they remain a source of raw material exports leaving the global south behind? What's your take? Do you believe the G20's critical minerals framework can deliver on its promises, or are there inherent flaws in the approach? Share your thoughts in the comments. Let's spark a conversation that could shape the future of global resource management.

title: Trump’s Shocking Plan for Ukraine — What Happens Next?
transcription: Hello everyone and welcome. A major political shock wave is shaking global diplomacy today. President Donald Trump has issued a direct ultimatum to Ukraine, and the deadline is just days away. Accept the peace plan or risk losing crucial US support is, Ukraine now standing at one of the most decisive moments in its history? Stay with me as we break down the full story. President Trump has presented a peace plan that appears surprisingly close to Russia's demands. The 28-point proposal calls for Ukraine to withdraw from the remaining parts of the Donbass region, reduce the size of its military, and abandon any intention of joining NATO. These are the same points Ukraine has repeatedly rejected in the past. On the battlefield, Ukraine is already under immense pressure. Russian drone strikes, constant bombardments, and difficult conditions on the eastern front. And now, pressure from the nation that has been its most important ally, the United States. President Zelensky has made it clear that Ukraine will not trade its dignity or freedom. But he also warned that if the United States steps back, the consequences for Ukraine could be severe. Zelensky has said, we need to find a balance to protect our freedom and also maintain our partnership with the US. But the Ukrainian public is strongly critical. Many believe this proposal would strengthen Russia, lift sanctions prematurely, and open the door for future conflicts by allowing Moscow to rebuild its military power. Meanwhile, the G20 summit is underway in South Africa. European leaders are present, France, Germany, the UK, all discussing how to respond to Trump's proposal. But the United States has boycotted the meeting. President Trump is not attending. So why isn't he there? Trump claims there is a genocide against white people in South Africa, a claim widely rejected by international organizations. He also criticized South Africa's land reforms. Some analysts say Trump simply opposes the multilateral framework that the G20 represents. The next few days will be critical. If Ukraine rejects Trump's plan, it risks losing essential US support. If it accepts the plan, it may have to surrender territory and compromise its long-term security. Either choice could reshape the course of this war and Ukraine's future. So what do you think? Will Ukraine stand firm or will international pressure force a compromise? Share your thoughts in the comments below. title: Ramaphosa closes G20 Summit, passes presidency to US for 2026 - nbc
transcription: As the G20 summit drew to a close at Nazrec, global attention shifted from the formalities of leadership transition to an unexpected diplomatic snag, one that became clear even before the ceremonial gavel could change hands. The handover of the gavel has yet to occur after President Ramaphosa's government declined to present it to the US Chargé d'Affaires in Pretoria, Mark Dillard. Ramaphosa made no mention of President Donald Trump or the recent tensions between Washington and Pretoria as he concluded the 2025 summit. Instead, he called for unity, adding that the G20 must demonstrate to the world that it has the capacity to confront and overcome global challenges. And together, we can ensure that no one is left behind. I now say that this gavel, this gavel of this G20 summit, formally closes this summit and now moves on to the next President of the G20, which is the United States, where we shall see each other again. The Trump administration has not publicly commented on the G20 leaders summit since Saturday. The newly adopted G20 declaration also reaffirms that members will cooperate under the US presidency in 2026 and reconvene in the UK in 2027 and Korea in 2028. Blanche Corses, NBC News, Johannesburg, South Africa.

title: 1814 - The London Beer Flood -  How a Brewery Flooded an Entire Neighborhood!
transcription: On the 17th of October 1814, a strange and destructive event took place at the Moe and Co. S Horseshoe brewery, located at the junction of Tottenham Court Road and Oxford Street in London, England. The brewery contained several enormous wooden vats, some of them 22 feet tall, filled with porter, a dark London beer that was extremely popular during that period. On that day, the hoop of one of the huge vats suddenly broke, causing the vat to burst and release its contents. The force of the escaping beer ruptured the stopcock of a second large vat, which also began to discharge. Several other vats were damaged in the chain reaction. In total, between 580,000 and 1,470,000 liters of porter flooded out, smashing through the brewery's rear wall, which was 25 ft high. Behind the brewery stood the St. Giles's rookery, one of London's poorest and most crowded slum districts. Once the wall collapsed, a wave of porter about 15 ft high swept into New Street and Great Russell Street, destroying homes and flooding basements. Everyone inside the brewery survived, but according to the coroner's report, eight people in the surrounding neighborhood were killed either by drowning, injuries from collapsing walls, or being trapped in flooded rooms. Eyewitnesses described the area afterwards as looking like the aftermath of an earthquake. Rumors later spread of people collecting the spilled beer, widespread drunkenness, and even deaths from alcohol poisoning in the following days. However, these stories appear exaggerated. The corner ruled that the disaster was an act of God, meaning the brewery was not held legally responsible and paid no compensation. The incident contributed to the decline of large wooden fermentation vats, which were eventually phased out across the brewing industry. The horseshoe brewery was later demolished. Today, the Dominion theater stands on the former site of the brewery. Thank you for watching. title: The largest polar bear ever
transcription: Have you ever wondered just how big can a polar bear really get? Today, we're diving into the story of the largest polar bear ever recorded, a true giant that shattered records and left scientists stunned. Let's rewind to 1960 in the icy region of Kotzebue Sound, Alaska. A group of hunters came across a truly enormous male polar bear and what they found would go down in history. This bear wasn't just large, it was colossal. When officially measured, the bear stood 11 ft 1 in 3.4 m tall when upright and weighed an unbelievable 2,209 lb. That's over 1 ton of arctic muscle and fur. To put that in perspective, that's heavier than a Toyota Corolla and taller than a basketball hoop when standing on its hind legs. Most adult male polar bears weigh between 900 and 1,500 lbs. So this monster of the North was far beyond the normal range. Scientists estimate it was likely in its prime and had access to an exceptional hunting territory, probably feeding on plenty of seals and possibly even beluga carcasses. Its skull alone was record-breaking, measuring 16.25 inches long and 11.75 inches wide, making it one of the largest carnivore skulls ever documented. The bear was later taxidermied and displayed. It serves as a powerful reminder of the extremes nature can produce and of the polar bear's status as one of Earth's ultimate apex predators. But here's the twist, as climate change continues to shrink arctic ice and reduce hunting grounds, polar bears are getting smaller on average. Experts warn that giants like the 1960 bear may never be seen again. What do you think? Could another bear like that still exist out there, hidden in the Arctic's endless white? Hit that like button, subscribe, and drop your thoughts in the comments below.

title: G20 summit opens in South Africa without Trump, Ukraine takes centre stage
transcription: Well, this G20 summit is unique for a few reasons. First of all, it's the first time in the 26-year history of G20s that leaders are meeting on this continent, the first time in Africa. It's also unique because it's the first G20 where the leaders of the three biggest economies are not present. No Russia, of course, no China, and the United States President Donald Trump, he's not here. He's boycotting this summit because he believes a genocide is being perpetrated against the white farmers of South Africa. He's wrong, that's a false claim, but that's uh that's Trump's belief. And yet, even though Trump is absent, he's really dominated the first few hours of the summit because of this peace plan that he wants to force on Ukraine. That peace plan was leaked yesterday, 28 points in it, and Trump has said that unless Zelensky, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accepts this peace plan by Thursday, the US may be looking at withdrawing military aid. For Zelensky, he says this is the most serious moment in Ukrainian history. Uh the peace plan would call for Ukraine to give up large chunks of the eastern part of its country to Russia. It would call on the Ukraine military to be weakened, and it would call on Ukraine to swear off uh joining NATO. Those are all non-starters for Ukraine. They're also non-starters for many of Ukraine's allies, Canada included. And so, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is stepping away from the summit activity to meet with European Council President Antonio Costa, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, French President Emmanuel Macron, and UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer. They'll all be stepping away to talk about how they can support Zelensky through this week ahead, what to do if in fact the US decides to pull military aid. Uh the Ukraine and the war uh war there has forced its way onto a summit which ostensibly was going to be about development, the Global South, uh new trade ties, etc. There will be that talk, but again, Ukraine has forced its way onto the agenda of this G20 summit. David Aken, Global News, Johannesburg.

title: Fire breaks out at COP30 as conference closes | BBC News
transcription:
That's the final day of the UN's climate change summit, COP 30 in Brazil. Yesterday, the conference had to be evacuated after a fire broke out inside the venue. More than 190 countries have been at the summit in an attempt to strengthen international efforts to address climate change. And on this final day, the delegation from Colombia say that more than 30 countries have signed a letter opposing a draft text because of it fails to refer to the phasing out of fossil fuels. Here's our climate editor, Justin Rowlett. 

The fire is really burning very intensely, burned a huge hole in the roof. The summit was halted yesterday afternoon when a fire broke out in the venue. The intense blaze was swiftly brought under control, but it meant yet another delay in these already fraught talks. They are as much about who isn't here as who is. Secretary General, what message do you want this conference to send to Donald Trump? We are waiting for you. Hope is the last thing that dies. He urged the summit to take bold action. One thing is clear. We are down to the wire and the world is watching Belem. But when the Brazilian President, Lula de Silva flew in, signs of agreement were proving elusive. These talks are being held behind closed doors. The most contentious issues, how to bridge the yawning gap between what countries say they'll do and what the science says is necessary to avoid the worst effects of climate change and how to get rich countries to deliver on promised cash to help poorer countries play their part. The big challenge as always at these talks is that the countries here can't force the others to actually do anything. So if a country doesn't want to phase out fossil fuels rapidly, for example, they don't have to, which means that the outcome of these summits is inevitably always a compromise. And if that compromise isn't ambitious, well, there will be questions about how effective this entire global process is. Justin Rowlett, BBC News, Belem.

title: VisionPro Glasses Review - Legit or Scam Product?
transcription: Yeah, so, Vision Pro Premium glasses claim to be this all-in-one multifocal solution that gives you perfect vision at every distance while being super lightweight and unbreakable. But a lot of people are still wondering, is this product actually legit? Let's break it down and make sure you watch this video till the end to get the full picture. The first concern comes from Trustpilot reviews. When we checked them, the feedback was overwhelmingly negative. People said the glasses were cheap, poorly made, and didn't work even though their eyesight matched the advertised range. Shipping took forever, refunds were a headache, and they were asked for unnecessary photos before getting their money back. Not a great start. Another concern is the buy one get one free offer. Sounds tempting, right? But this kind of aggressive discount is often used by low-quality brands just to push quick sales. Good and trustworthy brands rarely use gimmicks like this, so it definitely raises eyebrows. The third concern is their claim that the glasses are approved by ophthalmologists. But when we checked, nothing. No doctor names, no certificates, no endorsements, zero real proof. If something is medically approved, it always comes with verifiable details, which were missing here. The fourth concern is the promise of perfect near, intermediate, and distance vision. Sounds amazing, but we didn't find any scientific evidence, lab tests, or trials that support this claim. Without real proof, these statements feel more like marketing than reality. The fifth concern is the big statistics they advertise. 91% saw immediate improvement, 94% said the glasses were super durable, 92% felt more comfortable from the first minute. But again, no sources, no studies, nothing. When numbers have no proof behind them, they're basically meaningless. So, is Vision Pro Premium glasses legit? Based on everything we found, they really don't seem reliable. The bad reviews, the missing medical proof, the unrealistic claims, and the pushy discounts all raise major red flags. With so many customers reporting poor quality and refund issues, it's safer to avoid this brand and stick to trusted eyewear companies instead. Thanks for watching till the end. Make sure to subscribe for more honest reviews and updates.

title: Albanese arrives in South Africa for the G20 summit | ABC NEWS
transcription: World leaders are gathering here in Johannesburg for this weekend's G20 leaders summit, the first to be held on African soil. Anthony Albanese touched down earlier, welcomed by an honor guard and traditional dancers. Now, this should be South Africa's big moment to showcase its economic and diplomatic potential, but it's been overshadowed in the lead-up by the boycott of Donald Trump. The US president refusing to attend this weekend's summit over debunked claims that the South African government is violently persecuting white farmers. Up until today, the Trump administration was refusing to send any government officials, but South Africa's president Cyril Ramaphosa has indicated there has been a change of heart and the US now wants to participate in some form. For his part, Anthony Albanese insists this G20 summit is as relevant and important as ever. The G20 is such an important gathering. It's the most important gathering for which Australia is a member. It represents 85% of the global economy, 75% of global trade. It's important for us to engage because one in four of Australia's jobs depends upon trade and it is important therefore that I represent Australia at forums like this, advancing Australia's economic interest and supporting Australian jobs. Before the summit begins, the Prime Minister will honor three prominent Australians for the roles they played in ending apartheid here in South Africa, paying a visit to Freedom Park, where the names of former Prime Ministers Malcolm Fraser, Bob Hawke and former diplomat Bruce Hage have been inscribed on the wall of names, a memorial to those who fought for South Africa's freedom and democracy.

title: Intel Panther Lake: Low-Power, Multi-Tasking Demo
transcription: All right, Joe here at ITT. We're showcasing how we're bringing that Lunar Lake level efficiency with the scaled performance of Arrow Lake to our upcoming Panther Lake product. What you're seeing here are live power readings collected at the system level in this multitasking scenario. We have an active Teams meeting, Excel, PowerPoint, a browser here with 10 tabs open, actively watching a video. I know none of you in the tech world would ever think of doing this, but occasionally it happens. And we're using Hardware Info Pro here to show where that work is being done. On the Lunar Lake system and on the Panther Lake system, you'll see that work being contained to the low power island. But what you'll see here on Panther Lake is you still have all that additional core power that you'd expect from an Arrow Lake class system available. So all this compute cluster, which is not being needed right now for all this work being done, is still available for all your multi-threaded needs. Arrow Lake, which was limited to those just two LPE cores, not able to contain this work, which is why you see that at a higher power here. And that's what we're trying to showcase to you. title: John Cena’s Epic RAW Farewell at Madison Square Garden | WWE Recap । USA TODAY NEWS
transcription: Last night at Madison Square Garden, John Cena said goodbye. Not just to the world's most famous arena, but to his time on Monday Night Raw. And while it was bittersweet, it was also flat-out awesome. The show opened with his music hitting, and this time, the crowd actually got it right. No more John Cena sucks chants, just pure, loud, thank you Cena energy. Cena soaked it in, taking a few minutes to revel in the love before starting a heartfelt promo about what it all meant to him. Of course, no Cena farewell would be complete without a little chaos. Dominic Mysterio interrupted, and Judgment Day rallied around him, outnumbering Cena. Naturally, backup arrived in the form of Sheamus and Rey Mysterio, and suddenly, we had a six-man tag team match. At first, I thought it was a bit odd to go six-man instead of a one-on-one moment for Cena's farewell, but by the end, it worked perfectly. It was the kind of feel good story WWE does best. Good guys win, Cena hits every signature move, and you could see him having a blast with the other veterans. The crowd loved every second of it. Raw overall delivered after that. We saw the return of Dolph Ziggler, Roman Reigns and Brock Lesnar joining the men's War Games match in an intense main event brawl segment. AJ Lee made a shocking impact by costing Becky Lynch the women's Intercontinental Championship and Gunther had a standout match with Giovanni Evans. WWE treated Cena's farewell like the special occasion it was, and the entire show felt elevated. Rumors are already swirling that John Cena will headline the 2026 WWE Hall of Fame class, which makes you wonder if he was offered that honor backstage last night. Vince McMahon might not have been the right choice to induct him given his history, but who steps up now? Triple H is likely inducting Stephanie McMahon, so he's probably out. Could it be Randy Orton, CM Punk, or maybe a veteran legend like Kurt Angle or the Undertaker? Whatever happens, it'll be historic. Madison Square Garden provided the perfect backdrop for a proper farewell. Cena's energy, the crowd's love, and the celebration with his peers reminded everyone why he's one of the most iconic performers in WWE history. That night wasn't just about a goodbye, it was a celebration of a career that shaped an entire generation. And while the Hall of Fame speculation adds intrigue, last night was about one thing. Honoring Cena, the man, the performer, the legend. Fans got to witness a truly memorable Raw, and WWE delivered a show that will be talked about for years. Shout out to Netflix for giving us front row access to the magic.

title: AMD FINALLY Remembered About This! FSR Redstone
transcription: Back at Computex 2025, AMD teased us with something called FSR Redstone, which I and many others in the audience were excited about. And then things got quiet, very quiet. Despite the fact that they teased it as coming in the second half of 2025, and apparently they just remembered that it's almost the end of the year, because they announced a full reveal of what FSR Redstone will be for the 10th of December. But okay then, what is it exactly? Well, FSR Redstone isn't just one thing. In fact, it is multiple things all within the broader FSR ecosystem. The same way that on the Nvidia side of things, DLSS isn't just one feature. Rather, it includes everything from just regular upscaling to frame generation, to also ray reconstruction. And FSR Redstone will be a pretty similar thing, combining four different technologies. Those being ray regeneration, super resolution, frame generation, and new radiance caching. While some of them FSR already offered, others, like for example, ray regeneration are only just getting started, being introduced in Black Ops 7 as the first official title to actually support it. And the full reveal of what games will actually support this technology will of course come with the big announcement on the 10th of December. But then there's the question of who exactly can even run these things? Well, unfortunately, it's rather exclusive, because only Radeon 9,000 series graphics cards will be able to run FSR Redstone features. So, if you're running anything older or anything from other companies, then you can't experience any of it. Remember the days when FSR just ran flawlessly on any graphics card from any company? I remember that. But of course, as things get more complex and more hardware level features are required, then things can get obviously a bit confusing with what generations of what graphics cards can actually run all of these different upscaling features. But overall, it is looking rather promising and definitely a big step AMD needs to catch up with Nvidia on the software side of things. But what do you think about FSR Redstone thus far and are you excited for the big reveal? Let me know down in the comments below. And in the meantime, maybe check out our Patreon as well because even a single dollar a month truly goes a long way. Plus huge thanks to Gov Burns, Justin Rage, Runyak Polish Vock, but a pseudonym, Nexona, and Sheen Allcraft. But anyway, that's on it. I hope you enjoyed this video. If you did, then remember to subscribe, like, whatever, and I'll see you all in whatever I make next. Goodbye, everyone. Goodbye.

The Action 6 captures 4K video at up to 120 frames per second with full spectrum high dynamic range video recording at 4K per 60 frames per second. The Osmo Action 6 uses a 1,950 mAh Li-ion battery. The camera records to both 50 GB of built-in storage and supports micro SD cards up to 1 TB capacity. That's it for today's video. title: The Hidden Psychology of Club Penguin Avatars | Club Penguin Zero
transcription: Most worlds end once, but this one has died and returned more times than anyone can count. Every time the snow melts, the servers close, and then somehow someone brings it all back. When we return, we aren't just logging in. We're re-entering a piece of ourselves that we thought we'd outgrown. When we built these penguins, we didn't just pick colors or clothes. We built versions of who we hoped to be. The confident one in red, the quiet one in blue, the dreamer, the explorer, the one who finally fit in. We were shaping identity before we even knew the word for it. There is a psychological theory called the Proteus effect. It says when you change your avatar, your behavior changes with it. Maybe that's why the shy kids led the conga lines here. Maybe that's why the lonely ones hosted parties every night. It was safer to be bold when you were just made of pixels. In here, we could be someone else. And sometimes, that's the truest version of who we are. Every snowball was a conversation, every emote was a way of saying I see you in a language that nobody taught us. Connection didn't need a voice chat, just timing, intention, a small gesture across the screen. We were learning empathy without knowing its name. The dojo was the only place where stillness felt like progress. No coins, no leaderboards, just patience. For once, the goal wasn't just to win, it was to understand a rhythm and yourself. It's 2025, and somehow we are here again. Different people, same avatars. The penguins grew up, but they returned anyway. Maybe because this world never judged us for who we were or who we were trying to become. Every home we built here was a fragment of comfort. We arranged these rooms like we arranged our hearts, cluttered, colorful, and desperately personal. There's something tender about rebuilding a world no one asked you to bring back. Club Penguin Zero isn't about nostalgia. It's about proof that versions of ourselves we once loved still exist somewhere, waiting under the snow. We return to remember. We stay to rebuild. I've been delayed but I will be there around that time.

title: Taipei metro reveals “vault-like” doors installed after 2001 Typhoon Nari | Taiwan News | RTI
transcription: Curious commuters recently noticed a massive vault-like door near Exit 5 of Taipei Metro's Nanjing Fushing Station, sparking online speculation about its purpose. Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation clarified that the heavy, sealed structure is a flood barrier system, a vital defense mechanism designed after the devastating floods caused by Typhoon Nari in 2001. During that storm, floodwaters inundated the Blue Bannan Line and even swamped Taipei Main Station, reaching depths of up to 2.3 m. The disaster led Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation to design and install multiple waterproof systems across the network. If flooding threatens, this watertight door, 30 cm thick, can be closed to prevent water from entering the platform level, said CTS reporter Chang Hsiaoyun, while demonstrating the mechanism on site. According to Huang Yi Chao, a section chief from the Taipei City Department of Rapid Transit systems, the doors were introduced after engineers realized that flooding could easily overwhelm stations entrances. We decided to place basic waterproofing at the entrances and add full seal floodgates at station interfaces, he explained. The Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation uses several types of flood barriers, including swinging, vertical, and sliding models, to block water from penetrating underground areas. Although forecasts predict less rain from this week's Typhoon Fung Wong than from Nari, with expected totals around 300 mm over 2 days, city officials said the metro system remains on high alert to ensure uninterrupted service. Filip Stawski for ICRT News.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the massive, vault-like door discovered at the Taipei Metro's Nanjing Fuxing station?
questions.answer: The door is a heavy, sealed flood barrier system, specifically a 30-centimeter-thick watertight door designed to prevent floodwater from entering the platform level.

questions.question: What event prompted the installation of this and other flood defense systems in the Taipei Metro?
questions.answer: The devastating floods caused by Typhoon Nari in 2001, which inundated the metro system with water up to 2.3 meters deep in some stations, led the Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation to design and install these waterproof systems.

title: Steam Frame VR Headset: Full Reveal
transcription: Steam Frame is Valve's next-generation VR hardware. Stream all your Steam games, VR and non-VR alike, in this comfortable, lightweight, wireless VR headset. Steam Frame uses camera-based tracking, so getting into your games is as easy as slipping on the headset and waking it up. Steam Frame controllers, included with the headset, are designed with all the inputs you need for your VR titles, like motion controls and capacitive tracking for all your fingers, as well as a split gamepad layout to work with your whole Steam library. They even feature the same magnetic thumbsticks as Steam Controller for responsiveness and longevity. Steam Frame also pairs seamlessly with the new Steam control, a great companion for playing non-VR games in the headset. To make sure streaming is smooth and stable no matter what, Steam Frame includes a wireless adapter that lets you stream your games from your PC to your headset over a fast and dedicated Wi-Fi 6 connection. And the game is streamed to your frame optimized for VR, using new technology that allows for the highest resolution streaming exactly where your eyes are looking. And Steam Frame is a PC, running Steam OS. In addition to streaming, you can install and play a bunch of VR and non-VR games right in the headset without a host PC. You can also expand your onboard storage to fit even more games with a micro SD card.

title: Japan Rebukes Chinese Envoy’s Beheading Threat to PM Takaichi
transcription: A Chinese diplomat in Japan threatened to cut off the head of Japan's Prime Minister. The threat comes after Sanae Takaichi made comments on Taiwan-related issues. The Japanese government strongly protested the diplomat's remarks, calling them extremely inappropriate. The Chinese envoy deleted his terror-like post on X shortly afterward. Former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe had once warned that a Taiwan emergency is a Japan emergency. Shinzo Abe's remark suggests that a Chinese attack on Taiwan would directly affect Japan's security. The new Prime Minister Takaichi re-emphasized this statement with more clarity on Friday. She said that a Taiwan emergency could pose a threat to Japan's existence, implying that Japan could take military action if China attacks Taiwan. Shre Jen, the Chinese Consul General in Osaka, posted on X on Friday saying, quote, "The filthy head that recklessly sticks itself in must be cut off without a moment's hesitation." On Monday, Japan's Chief cabinet Secretary called the post extremely inappropriate and urged Beijing to take appropriate action. However, the Chinese Foreign Ministry defended the envoy's remarks during his Monday press briefing. Although Shre Jen deleted the terror-like post, he continues posting similar messages on X. These included posts saying, quote, a Taiwan emergency is a Japan emergency. It's a fatal path that some stupid Japanese politicians are trying to take and that dialogue is no longer possible. The US Ambassador to Japan weighed in, saying the Chinese diplomat had threatened Japan's Prime Minister and that Beijing's behavior once again shows misconduct. Prime Minister Takaichi says she has no intention of withdrawing her remarks on Taiwan. A major Chinese offensive against Taiwan would disrupt global supply chains, which rely on the Taiwan straight for 99% of trade, while also strengthening China's military position in the region. Takaichi, who took office last month, is the first Japanese Prime Minister to outline a specific scenario that could justify military intervention.

title: Kendrick Lamar tops Grammys 2026 nominations, Lady Gaga and Bad Bunny follow, and no Taylor Swift?
transcription: Grammy season has officially begun and the nominees are serving hits on hits on hits. The 68th annual Grammy Awards are set for February 1st, 2026, and the Recording Academy just dropped the full list of nominations. Spoiler alert, it's Kendrick Lamar's world and we're all just streaming in it. That's right, Kendrick leads the pack with nine nominations, thanks to his critically acclaimed album G&X, which dropped last November. Right behind him, Lady Gaga, who scored seven nominations, breaking her own record from way back in 2010. Her latest album, Mayhem, clearly lived up to its name in the best way. But this year's Grammys aren't just about the icons. Rising star Leon Thomas made major waves with six nominations, including Best New Artist. Sharing that six-nod spotlight are Sabrina Carpenter, Serban Ghenea, and Bad Bunny, who if you forgot, is performing at the Super Bowl just one week after the Grammys. No rest for Benito. And speaking of Bad Bunny, he's making history as the first Spanish-language artist ever nominated for Album of the Year, Record of the Year, and Song of the Year, all in the same year. And people still question his halftime show credentials? Please. Other big names in the mix, Tyler, the Creator, and Doechii with five nods each. Justin Bieber with four, and Bruno Mars, Miley Cyrus, and Selena Gomez rounding out the list with a few well-earned mentions. Oh, and get this. Timothée Chalamet just scored his first Grammy nomination for the Bob Dylan biopic soundtrack, A Complete Unknown. That's right, from the Oscars to the Grammys, Timmy is collecting trophies like vinyls. Now, if you're wondering, where's Taylor Swift? Don't panic, Swifties. Her latest album, The Life of a Showgirl, came out just after the eligibility window closed. But don't worry, she's practically a lock in for the 2027 Grammys. The 2026 Grammy Awards will take place live from the crypto.com arena in Los Angeles on February 1st. A host hasn't been announced yet, but with a lineup this stacked, all eyes are going to be on the categories. Who will take home the gold? We'll find out in February. Until then, cue the playlist because Grammy season is officially on repeat.

title: Anthropic's Code Execution GAME CHANGER Cuts LLM Tokens by 98%
transcription: Your AI agents are burning tokens like crazy and it's not your prompt's fault. It's the architecture. Anthropic just dropped the biggest update yet, MCP code execution, and it changes everything about how agents work and can save up to 98% tokens. I'll explain what's new, why MCP needed this upgrade, and I'll show you a real demo that anyone can run locally. Typically, every MCP server exposes 10 to 20 tools. Every tool comes with function description, parameters, types, examples that translates into tens of thousands of tokens. All irrelevant for 90% of tasks. And this is where accuracy drops because the model is drowning in noise. It keeps confusing tools, mixing parameters, hallucinating schema fields, and failing mid-workflow. This is the new mental model behind MCP. Instead of dumping every tool definition into the model's context window, tools appears as a file system. To get the exact estimates, I generated a synthetic cloud watch style data set that looks exactly like what real DevOps engineers deal with. So, it has data for 150 EC2 instances. Each instance has 50 to 150 CPU data points. What the script does is loads the entire data set as raw text. This means all 18,000 data points become part of the prompt. The LLM has to read the entire JSON block. This turns into 355,000 tokens, which is almost double of what the token limit of the LLM is, and ultimately the LLM is choked. It throws a quota exceeded error where the limit is just 125,000 tokens. Now, let's take a look at the MCP style flow, where the model doesn't touch the data set. We filter the data set locally. The local Python finds the high CPU instances. Only the tiny summary is passed into the model. Gemini responds instantly. Token usage drops from 355,000 to 2096. That's more than 98% token savings. And this is the magic. The LLM sees only the result, not the 18,000 data points. This is why MCP code execution is such a big deal. Instead of forcing LLMs to parse huge tool definitions and giant JSON blobs, we let the model write code on which it is exclusively trained on, and we only give it the tiny slice of data it actually needs. Let me know in the comments what you think about MCP code execution. See you in the next video.

questions.question: What is the primary problem with AI agents that the speaker addresses at the beginning of the audio?
questions.answer: The primary problem is that AI agents are "burning tokens like crazy," not due to bad prompts, but because of the underlying architecture which forces all tool definitions into the model's context, creating noise and causing errors.

questions.question: What is the name of the new update mentioned, and what is its most significant benefit?
questions.answer: The update is called "MCP Code Execution," and its most significant benefit is the ability to save up to 98% on token usage.

questions.question: In the speaker's demo, what was the token usage for the old method versus the new MCP-style flow?
questions.answer: The old method used 355,000 tokens, which was over the model's limit. The new MCP-style flow reduced this to just 2,096 tokens.

title: Evacuations ordered as Typhoon Fung-wong slams into the Philippines | ABC NEWS
transcription: Super Typhoon Fung-wong has made landfall in the Philippines north just a week after more than 200 people were killed by Typhoon Kalmaegi in the country's center. Fung-wong is one of the largest typhoons to hit the Philippines in years with an 18,000 km wide rain and wind band. At least two people have been killed. The system has forced the evacuation of more than a million people on the Philippines' most populous island. President Marcos Jr. has declared a state of emergency. Typhoon Fung-wong is battering the island of Luzon with torrential rain and sustained winds of 185 km/h, gusting up to 230 km/h. The system is projected to move towards the Taiwan Strait, weakening before making landfall in Taiwan. Vision emerging from the Southeast Asian country shows the extent of tidal surges during the typhoon, reaching as high as 3 m. While the north battles severe weather, search and rescue missions are still continuing after Typhoon Kalmaegi wreaked havoc in central Philippines last week. At least 224 people were killed, and another 135 people remain missing.

transcription: Welcome. Today we delve into the ADAAS model, a powerful tool to elevate your communication. The ADAAS model is a structured approach that guides your audience through the journey of communication. Are you ready to learn the secrets of successful communication? Let's get started. Attention is the first crucial step. You need to capture your audience's attention immediately. In a world of information overload, a structured approach is key to making your message stand out. Use powerful headlines, striking images, and focus on the benefit for your audience to grab attention. Once you have attention, you must spark interest. This is where you engage your audience further. Reveal the hook by making your message relevant to your audience. This is about you. Engage interest with facts, relatable stories, and highlight how your product or idea solves their problem. Now, transform interest into desire. Your audience should want what you're offering. title: Savannah Ghosts: The Most Elusive Animals Ever Filmed | African Mysteries 1518
transcription: Picture this. The African Savannah at dusk, golden grass waving and shadows creeping across the landscape. Now, forget the lions and elephants for a second. Today, I'm diving deep into the real ghosts of the Savannah. These are the animals even seasoned rangers barely glimpse, the ones whispered about around campfires. Let's start with the Aardvark, a creature so shy it's called the Phantom of the night. With its piggy snout and rabbit ears, it snuffles through termite mounds under the cover of darkness, vanishing before dawn. Next up, the pangolin. Imagine a living pine cone on legs, armored against predators but not against poachers. They curl up tight, and spotting one in the wild, that's a lifetime achievement for any wildlife lover. But the Savannah's secrets go deeper. Ever heard of the serval? These long-legged cats can leap 10 feet straight up to nab a bird mid-flight, yet their golden coats blend perfectly with the grass, making them nearly invisible. And then, the black-footed cat. Don't let its cuteness fool you. It's Africa's deadliest hunter by success rate, yet most locals have never seen one outside a photograph. Filmmakers and scientists spend months, sometimes years just trying to catch a glimpse. Every now and then, trail cameras give us a fleeting look, reminding me that the Savannah still holds mysteries. So next time you think you know Africa's wildlife, remember, the ghosts of the grasslands are always watching, always a step ahead. What would you do to see one of these legends in real life? title: How To Sync Apple Watch To Strava? Connect Apple Health Data To Strava App!
transcription: Want to sync your Apple Watch or Apple Health data and workouts to Strava? Well, in this video, I'll show you the step-by-step process to connect your Strava account to Apple Health. But before we start with the steps, make sure that you have both the Apple Health and the Strava app on your iPhone, and you log in to your Strava account. The first thing that you want to do is open the Apple Health app. On the Health app homepage, tap on the profile icon in the top right. Under the privacy section, you'll find the apps option. Open it and select Strava. Here you'll see two sections. Allow Strava to write and allow Strava to read. Turn on the toggles below the allow Strava to read section. This allows the Strava app to only read your Apple Health data and not overwrite it. Unless you want that, in which case you can also turn on all. Now, open the Strava app, go to the U section and tap on this gear icon. Now from this list, select manage apps and devices. Under the services section, you'll find the health app. Open it and again tap on the health app and tap on connect. Now from here, you can select what data you want to sync. Allow Strava to write will sync the data from Strava app to the Health app. Whereas allow Strava to read will sync the data from the Health app to the Strava. After making this selection, tap on allow. And now as you can see, Strava is now connected with the Health app. Here it shows a demo activity I just did before syncing. By tapping on import, I can transfer all the workout data from Apple Watch to Strava. You can import all workouts from your Apple Watch for the last 90 days to your Strava account. As soon as the import is finished, reload the activities page and you'll see your workouts on the Strava app. Here is the same activity open on my Apple Watch Series 10. And as you can see, the distance and duration is on point. The calorie burn is also accurate. Apple Watch shows my average pace is 11:53, whereas on the Strava, it shows us 11:52. And the average heart rate is a little bit off. But other than that, the sync is pretty accurate. And that's how you can link or connect your Apple Watch with Strava. If you found this video helpful, then leave a like and subscribe to your Holic for more variable videos. Thanks for watching.

title: World leaders gather in Brazil for COP30 climate summit
transcription: A bold plan by Brazil inviting the UN climate conference to Belém, barely equipped to host tens of thousands of guests. For the first time in history, a climate cope will take place in the heart of the Amazon. Brazil's president launched an international fund to help countries slow deforestation and to protect tropical rainforests like the Amazon, but hasn't yet raised the 25 billion dollars to kick it off. 10 years on from the Paris pledge to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees, a sobering message. President Lula, you have called this the COP of truth. I could not agree more. And the hard truth is that we have failed to ensure we remain below 1.5 degrees. The world is still warming, global emissions still rising, supercharging storms like those lashing the Philippines and Vietnam this week. But there is significant progress in that decade, says Guterres. Clean energy is winning in price, performance, and potential. What is still missing is political courage. COP 30 convenes with a climate skeptic in the White House, and for the first time, no high-level US delegation. Prime Minister Carney, formerly the UN's climate finance envoy, isn't here. His office says because of the budget vote. Our attention has been drawn to other threats and crises that can seem more pressing. These talks will need to break through the tariff wars and divisive politics. Brazil's president says the era of fine speeches and good intentions is over. People are demanding action. Canada's delegation arrives next week, including both the current environment minister and the former one. Susan Ormiston, CBC News, Belem, Brazil.

title: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S40 — Specs, Features & Early Impressions
transcription: Meet the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S40. Xiaomi's newest budget friendly cleaner that promises big suction power and smart navigation, all at a surprisingly reasonable price. Now officially available in Europe and the UK, the S40 is priced at 169.99 pounds in the UK and 199.99 euros in Germany. And yes, that includes free shipping. It might look simple, but this compact robot hides some serious tech under the hood. At its core is LiDAR navigation, the same laser-guided system found in higher-end models. It carefully maps your home for efficient room-by-room cleaning. The design is minimalist, and the charging dock, compact and discreet. Perfect for small apartments or tight spaces. But the real star here is power. With 10,000 pascals of suction, the Xiaomi S40 easily tackles dust, crumbs, and pet hair, even from carpets. Its specially designed main brush minimizes tangles, and the side brush is hair-resistant, saving you from the usual maintenance headaches. On a single charge, it can run for up to 180 minutes. That's enough to cover most homes in one go. The 520 ml dustbin isn't massive, but considering its compact design, it gets the job done. Just remember, there's no self-emptying feature, so you'll need to empty it manually every few sessions. As for mopping, let's keep expectations realistic. The S40 drags a damp cloth behind it for light cleaning, ideal for removing surface dust or minor spills. But there are no rotating pads or deep scrubbing action here. Think of it as a finishing touch rather than a full mop replacement. For the price, the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S40 strikes a smart balance. Strong suction, efficient navigation, and essential functionality without the luxury price tag. It's the kind of robot that simply gets the job done, quietly, efficiently, and affordably. If you're after a dependable cleaning companion that won't break the bank, the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum S40 might just sweep you off your feet.

title: SpaceX Launches 28 Starlink Satellites: Falcon 9 Booster Lands Successfully (Video)
transcription: Get ready for a thrilling journey into the world of SpaceX and its ambitious Starlink project. SpaceX just launched another batch of 28 Starlink satellites, and the story behind these launches is truly out of this world. Imagine, if you will, a world where every time SpaceX sends up a new set of these broadband satellites, you get a little richer, or at least a little more well-nickled. That's right. SpaceX has been busy and their Falcon 9 booster, known as 1093, has had quite the adventure. This particular booster, after its eighth flight, successfully separated its stages, performed deceleration burns, and then gracefully landed on a drone ship in the Pacific Ocean, all within 8.5 minutes of liftoff. Talk about precision. But here's where it gets controversial. Booster 1093, now riding the drone ship named Of Course I still love you back to port, will be refurbished and readied for future launches. Some might question the environmental impact of such frequent launches and refurbishments. While B1093 was making its way back to Earth, the Falcon 9's upper stage continued its mission, carrying the 28 Starlink satellites to their deployment point in LEO, low Earth orbit. These satellites will join the ever-growing Starlink mega constellation, currently consisting of over 8,800 spacecraft providing wireless internet to customers worldwide. Today's launch was the 142nd Falcon 9 mission of the year, with a whopping 102 dedicated to expanding the Starlink network. That's a lot of launches and a lot of satellites. And this is the part most people miss, SpaceX's commitment to reusable rockets and sustainable space exploration. So, what do you think? Are these frequent launches a sign of progress or a cause for concern? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments. We'd love to hear your perspective on this exciting, yet complex, aspect of space exploration and its potential impact on our world.

There are muted expectations for the conference without a high-level US presence in attendance, and as a key goal from the Paris Agreement is set to be missed in the next decade, with aims to limit global warming to 1.5° Celsius appearing to fail. Brazil's foreign minister stressed the importance of the moment. The COP meeting holds fundamental importance at this moment, and during this meeting, we will launch several initiatives. The most significant of these is an innovation. It is the TFFF, which stands for the Tropical Forests Forever Fund. Also on the agenda, COP 30 will be talk of transitioning away from fossil fuels, aims to raise a target of 1.3 trillion to assist developing countries to tackle climate change, and plans to boost the global capacity for renewable energy. The conference is being held in Belém, a gateway city to the Amazon rainforest. The symbolic location has proved controversial. Brazil has been criticized for building a new highway to reach the city, as well as recently giving the green light for oil drilling near the Amazon river. NGOs and protest groups are also gathering ahead of the conference, hoping to apply pressure on the attending dignitaries. We're going to ask the Brazilian government, the world, the leaders of other countries to respect indigenous people, to respect indigenous lands, and to recognize the indigenous lands that have yet to be demarcated. title: LA Dodgers Star Kiké Hernández Trolls Drake During World Series Parade  ‘October's Very Own'
transcription: LA Dodgers star Kiké Hernández trolls Drake during World Series parade: October's Very Own. As if losing a gut-wrenching Game 7 weren't bad enough for Drake and the Toronto Blue Jays, the hits kept coming during the Los Angeles Dodgers' World Series parade on Monday. Outfielder Kiké Hernández had some fun at Drake's expense and took a playful shot at Drizzy when addressing the Dodger Stadium crowd on the mic. It's October's very own, he said, which felt as if he was ripping a WWE promo. Hernández later made a witty reference to lyrics from Drake and Future's 2015 hit, Big Rings. This really big team that has a lot of really big rings, he said. The Dodgers have captured three World Series titles since 2020 and became the first franchise to go back-to-back since the New York Yankees in 1999 and 2000. Drake was in attendance for a couple of the World Series games in Toronto, and even after the torturous extra-innings loss in Game 7, the six god thanked the team for a dream season. Congrats to the Jays for a dream season and a legendary World Series fight, he wrote to his IG story. After the Jays took a 3-2 series lead following Game 5, Drake even had some fun trolling Dodgers superstar Shohei Ohtani with a pair of posts to his IG story. However, it came back to bite Drake once the Dodgers won the next two games in Toronto, including a classic Game 7 by a score of 5-4, which ripped the hearts out of Canada's team, which was inches from capturing its first title since 1993. The Dodgers poured salt in the wound for Drake when referencing lyrics from Kendrick Lamar's scathing, Not Like Us anthem in a team photo on social media after clinching the World Series on Saturday night. They still not like us, the Dodgers wrote.

Mark, you'd make a quarter of a billion dollars. There's a lot you can do with this money. Um, and it was, well, I don't know what I'd do with the money. I would just start another social networking site. But I kind of like the one I have, so why would I get rid of it? title: Charles Coste (1924–2025): The World’s Oldest Olympian Has Passed Away 🕊️ । USA TODAY NEWS
transcription: Charles Coste, the world's oldest living Olympian and a celebrated cycling champion, has passed away at the age of 101. The French presidency confirmed that Coste died last Thursday, leaving behind a legacy that spanned more than a century of dedication to sport. Coste first rose to international prominence at the 1948 Olympic Games in London, capturing the gold medal in the men's team pursuit at the historic Herne Hill Velodrome. Alongside teammates Pierre Adam, Serge Blusson, and Fernand Decanali, the quartet, known as the ABCD team, won by nearly 40 seconds over Italy, marking the largest margin of victory in Olympic cycling history. His accomplishments didn't end there. Coste went on to compete professionally with the Peugeot team, claiming victory at the prestigious 1949 Grand Prix des Nations, where he defeated Italian cycling legend Fausto Coppi. Over his career, he rode in two Tours de France and four Giros d'Italia, retiring from professional cycling in 1959. After hanging up his wheels, he pursued a new path as a sales inspector for La Blanchisserie de Grenelle, Europe's largest laundry, demonstrating the same discipline and commitment off the track that had defined his athletic career. More than 70 years after his Olympic triumph, Coste returned to the spotlight as one of the final bearers of the Olympic flame for the 2024 Paris Games. In a moving moment during the rain-soaked opening ceremony, he wheeled himself into the stadium dressed entirely in white, lighting the torches of French Olympic gold medalists Teddy Riner and Marie-José Pérec. That moment symbolized the passion and spirit of transmission that drove him, Riner said. Charles Coste embodied dedication, respect, and love for sport in all its forms. Emmanuel Macron's office praised Coste as, until his final breath, the tireless messenger of a certain idea of sport, highlighting not only his athletic achievements, but also his enduring role as an inspiration to generations. Following the passing of Hungarian gymnast Ágnes Keleti earlier this year, Coste had held the distinction of being the oldest living Olympic champion, a testament to his longevity and influence in sport. From pedaling a wooden tricycle as a child near Toulon to becoming a national and Olympic hero, Charles Coste's life was defined by dedication, excellence, and the pursuit of greatness. France and the global cycling community have lost a legend, but his achievements and the inspiration he provided will be remembered forever. The President of the Republic and his wife pay tribute to the memory of this champion who left his mark on the history of his sport and of the nation, Macron's office said, offering condolences to Coste's family and cycling enthusiasts worldwide.

title: How Did Journalists Cover The Berlin Wall's Construction? - I'm a 60s Baby
transcription: How did journalists cover the Berlin Wall's construction? Imagine waking up to a city suddenly divided overnight. That's exactly what happened on August 13, 1961, when the Berlin Wall began to rise. Journalists were quick to report this startling change, capturing the shock and confusion felt by Berliners. News outlets described how barbed wire and barricades appeared suddenly, cutting East Berlin off from West Berlin. Reporters used vivid words like barbed wire, steel barriers, and military presence to paint a picture of the tense scene. Radio stations, especially from the American sector, played a vital role. Stations like Radio in the American Sector provided live updates, warning people about the new restrictions and urging caution. Journalists on the ground described soldiers reinforcing the wall with steel barriers and East German troops patrolling the border. Newspapers in the West published eyewitness accounts, emphasizing how families were separated and freedoms restricted. They highlighted the speed of construction and the human toll of this sudden division. West Berlin's leaders, including the mayor, expressed outrage and called for support from Western allies. These statements were widely covered, showing the political tension. The East German government initially denied plans to build a wall, with leaders like Walter Ulbricht claiming there was no intention to do so. As the wall went up, journalists reported on this contradiction, illustrating the propaganda battles happening alongside the physical construction. International coverage also focused on the broader Cold War tensions. Reports described US troop movements and the famous tank confrontation at Checkpoint Charlie later that year. Journalists framed the wall as a symbol of communist oppression and the deep ideological divide between East and West. During the 1960s, coverage was full of urgency and emotion. Reporters told stories of fear, hope, and resilience of Berliners living through one of the Cold War's most defining moments. They combined eyewitness accounts with political analysis, capturing the era's style of reporting. This coverage helped the world understand the significance of the Berlin Wall's construction and its impact on global politics.

title: How much security is at the New York Marathon?
transcription: The operation is led by the NYPD alongside private security firms and other city agencies. There are police on nearly every block, drones in the air, sniffer dogs, and police boats guarding the harbor. Bag checks are common and large bags are banned around the finish area. There are also plain clothed police officers embedded in the crowds. After the tragic events of the Boston Marathon bombings, New York City significantly increased surveillance with thousands of cameras covering the course. Evacuation plans and emergency routes are mapped for every segment of the race. Thankfully, these are almost always just precautionary. There are over 1,500 medical personnel supporting the marathon, including doctors, nurses, EMTs, and volunteers. Medical tents are placed roughly every mile or two with major field hospitals near the finish and higher risk areas. Mobile medical teams patrol in fast response cars. Defibrillators are kept at regular intervals and especially in dense spectator zones. Each runner's bib holds essential info for rapid identification. They fill out any medical conditions and emergency contacts so medics have access to that instantly. Thankfully, most issues are minor though: cramps, dehydration, and exhaustion. Because the medical layout is so dense, response times are often under a minute.

title: Insta360 X4 Air : First Look - Review Full Specifications
transcription: Earlier this year, Insta 360 introduced the latest X5 action camera and later followed with the X5 Satin white limited edition variant, which we reviewed last month. Now, the action camera manufacturer Insta 360 has launched a new 360° action camera in its X series, the Insta 360 X4 Air. The company has advertised the X4 Air as the lightest ever, 8K 360° action camera in the brand's roster. Dimension-wise, it measures 46 x 113.8 x 37 mm, 1.81 x 4.48 x 1.45 in, and weighs just 165 g, 0.36 lbs, which is almost equal to the smartphone's weight. By contrast, the original X4 has the same dimensions, but it's slightly heavier than the X4 Air, weighing in at 203 g, 0.44 lbs. Insta 360 has incorporated dual 1/1.8-inch CMOS sensors into the X4 Air, which further helps to capture footage with better detail and more vivid colors. Like the X5, the action camera also ships with Insta 360's intelligent exposure algorithm, adaptive tone. Speaking of imaging capabilities, the CMOS sensor outputs at 29 megapixels with an F 1.95 aperture and a 6.4 mm equivalent focal length. It can capture 360° videos at up to 8K 30 FPS. Despite boasting a compact form factor, Insta 360 has managed to squeeze in a 2010 mAh battery into the X4 Air, and the brand claims that it offers up to 100 minutes of runtime when recording footage at 6K 24 FPS. While shooting at 8K 30 FPS, users can expect a runtime of around 88 minutes. Interestingly, like the X5, the latest X4 Air also supports user-replaceable lenses. On the positive side, it does offer all video modes from the flagship X5 action camera, including 360° video, active HDR, Instaframe mode, time-lapse, loop recording, road mode, and more. Furthermore, it's equipped with Insta 360's flow state stabilization and 360° horizon lock, which handles image stabilization related things. Users can easily auto-edit 360° footage, export videos, and edit images via the Insta 360 app. Unlike the X4, the Insta 360 X4 Air is compatible with most X5 accessories. Moreover, the action camera is rated at 49 ft, 15 m, and supports gesture controls.
