title: Eintracht Frankfurt - Union Berlin | 3-4 | Highlights | Bundesliga 2025-26 | frankfurt union berlin
transcription: Welcome to today's Bundesliga match between Eintracht Frankfurt and Union Berlin. Sixth-placed Frankfurt will be eager to return to winning ways in the league following their defeat to Bayer Leverkusen. They should be full of confidence, however, after a spectacular 5-1 victory against Galatasaray in the Champions League just on Thursday. The Eagles have been a formidable attacking force, scoring at least three goals in four of their five matches this season. Their opponents, 14th-placed Union Berlin, are looking to bounce back from a 4-2 loss to Hoffenheim where they conceded twice in first half stoppage time. Head coach Stefan Baumgart's side have created more big chances this campaign but have been vulnerable at the back, conceding seven times in two games. Union will draw confidence from their strong recent record against Frankfurt, being undefeated in the last three meetings, including a 2-1 win here last season. This promises to be a fascinating contest between two teams aiming to climb the table. The visitors stunned the home crowd early on. In the ninth minute, Ilias Ansa punished a Frankfurt mistake, receiving the ball from Luca Ilich and smashing a spectacular long-range effort into the net. Union doubled their lead on the counter attack in the 33rd minute. Ilich held off defenders and slipped a perfect through ball for Oliver Burke, who outpaced his marker and finished clinically. Frankfurt found a crucial response just before halftime. Nathaniel Brown cut in from the left and his shot took a decisive deflection off Ken Uzen, wrong-footing the goalkeeper to make it 2-1. Union Berlin restored their two-goal advantage early in the second half. In the 53rd minute, Ansa won the ball and found Ilich, who delivered a pinpoint cross for Burke to head home powerfully. A VAR review checked for offside, but the goal was confirmed. Burke then completed his hat trick on the hour mark, latching onto a sublime chipped return pass from Ilich before lofting the ball over the advancing goalkeeper. Frankfurt dominated possession, but struggled to break down a resolute Union defense, with their best second-half chance seeing Uzen head a free kick wide. Despite a late flurry of substitutions from both managers, Union Berlin saw out a memorable and clinical away victory.

Even during construction, supporters can witness the progress through a special viewpoint on a stadium tour. A glimpse of the transformation in motion. The comeback to Camp Nou marks more than just a return to home soil. It's the promise of louder nights, bigger atmospheres and crucially, a new era of financial stability for the club through increased revenue streams. For Barcelona, the message is simple. Chinese Communist Party out! Chinese Communist Party out!

Ladies and gentlemen, why are Chinese people electing our president?

Merchants along with Chinese tourists we consulted articulated their notable dissatisfaction and anxiety. As they shout those harsh words, all the foreign tourists leave, and I can't do any business at all. We feel bad and scared about this protest.

title: Ronald Ding, the mind behind @shadeformai
transcription: Everyone, my name is Ronald. I'm the CTO and co-founder at Shadeform. Before Shadeform, I worked at Robin Hood and also at AWS. My co-founder worked at Azure, so between the two of us, we come from a cloud background. We've worked a lot on cloud services and we've taken what we've learned at those companies and built Shadeform. What we do at Shadeform is we have built a single API that abstracts over 15 plus different cloud providers and data centers that offer GPUs. If you're familiar with the GPU shortage, you know that for a really long time, finding GPU hardware, finding GPU instances and VMs to run your applications was extremely difficult. What we did is build a single API that allows you to provision GPUs in any of the clouds and data centers that we support, and it also allows you to view the real-time availability and pricing of all these GPUs so that you can make your GPU purchasing decision just from one single platform. We also support two modes of deploying GPUs. You can either provide us with your API key for that cloud provider, or you can deploy in a managed account and that we manage, and that way you don't have to deal with the end cloud provider at all, but you still have the full scope of all the GPU cloud providers that we offer. With all the aggregated availability, we've had over we've had 100% GPU availability over the last 12 months. At any point over the last 12 months, you could have come to Shadeform and gotten an A100 on demand or an H100 on demand.

Britain's wealth was built through centuries of extraction and we have the responsibility to support those communities who are still living with the consequences. When the UK invests in aid, it helps undo those inequalities and builds a safer world for everyone. Hello, my name is Mariana, and I would like to say that I think that ODA isn't just about helping others, it's about fairness as well. Supporting ODA means choosing cooperation over exploitation and creating conditions for real justice and dignity worldwide. Thank you so much. title: Safari Lion Documentary 🦁 | Wild African Lions Hunting & Family Life | Full Wildlife Documentary 4K
transcription: Safari Lion documentary. At the heart of Africa's wild plains lives one of the most iconic animals in the world, the lion. Known as the king of the Savannah, this majestic predator rules through power, intelligence, and cooperation. Today, we follow the life of the lion from the pride to the hunt and explore what it takes to survive in the wild. Lions are the only cats that live in large social groups called prides. A pride usually consists of related lionesses, their cubs, and a few dominant males. Life in the pride revolves around teamwork. The lionesses share responsibilities, nursing cubs, defending territory, and hunting for food. Play may look harmless, but for these cubs, it's essential training. Each leap and pounce prepares them for the skills they will need as adults. A male lion with a heavy mane patrolling. The males may not hunt as often, but their role is vital. Their massive size and powerful roar deter rivals. A lion's roar can travel up to five miles across the savannah, warning intruders to stay away. Lions are ambush predators. They hunt mainly at night when the cover of darkness gives them the advantage. The females coordinate silently, spreading out to cut off escape routes. Only one in four hunts succeeds. But when the pride works together, their chances improve dramatically. Tonight their patience is rewarded. A successful hunt means survival, not just for the hunters, but for the entire. Even kings face challengers. Hyenas, scavengers, and vultures constantly compete for a share of the lion's meal. A feeding frenzy can quickly turn violent. Strength and numbers often decide who eats and who goes hungry. Cubs are the most vulnerable members of the pride. Less than half survive their first two years. Predators, hunger, and even rival lions pose constant threats. Only under the care and protection of their mothers can they hope to reach adulthood. Life on the savannah is a delicate balance. Every day brings challenges, from hunger to rivalries. Yet through strength, unity, and resilience, lions endure. They remain symbols of courage and guardians of the wild plains. The roar of the lion is the heartbeat of Africa, a reminder that even in a land of constant struggle, the king of beasts still reigns.

And the book isn't the only good news for fans. We've been told that there is talk about a possible new album and maybe a tour next year. Now, Adele hasn't been on a world tour since 2017. title: Chinese EVs challenge German giants at Europe's largest auto show in Munich
transcription:
It's one of the world's largest motor shows, drawing in hundreds of thousands of visitors, lured by the prospect of a glimpse at futuristic electric vehicles, but also at the more realistic options the major manufacturers are offering. And at this year's show, Chinese cars are hard to miss. 30 years ago, carmaker BYD did not even exist, but now its vehicles are on show like never before, and its message seems clear.
Our clear goals are to be perceived as a European brand. We now also manufacture in Europe, combined with a very broad product portfolio. We now have 11 vehicles in the lineup and we're very proud of that. We really cover 90% of the product segments in the German car market.
These are some of their latest offerings, a mixture of hybrid vehicles and fully electric ones. Using flash charging, BYD says EV drivers will be able to go from next to nothing to around 200 kilometers range in just a few minutes. But some of their European competitors are skeptical. 
Volkswagen still leads in terms of new car sales in Europe, despite the perception that some of its existing EVs have been unpopular. For this firm it seems, the automotive offerings on show here are the way ahead.
New competition coming in, so we will readjust with this and now with the electric vehicles we're bringing in, plus another seven new electric vehicles by '27. We have a fantastic lineup that can compete with any of these newcomers. That they will, that the Chinese competition will come to Europe was always clear, and we will face it.

This is particularly useful when the camera is mounted on a helmet or in other hard to reach places. Beyond the core features, the Veeran V11 offers a range of shooting modes, including loop recording, slow fast motion, driving mode, time lapse, and continuous shooting. These modes add versatility and allow you to get creative with your content. It also has manual exposure control. The Veeran V11 uses micro SD cards for storage, which is standard for action cameras. title: FIRST LOOK - iPhone 17 Pro Max Hands On Review!
transcription: We are only three days away from the Apple event, and today we received some surprising new information about the future iPhone from Apple. According to a leaked South Korean telecom spec sheet, which is an internal technical document provided to mobile network operators by smartphone makers such as Apple and Samsung before a phone's official debut. Almost everything regarding the iPhone 17 lineup is detailed here. Let's start with the size. The Pro models maintain the same display sizes. The iPhone 17 Pro will feature a 6.3-inch display, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max will have a gigantic 6.9-inch display. The iPhone 17 Air, Apple's latest thin iPhone, will have a 6.6-inch display, while the normal iPhone 17 will have a 6.3-inch screen. Importantly, all iPhones in this series will include a 120 Hz promotion display. The iPhone 17 Air will include a high-density battery, but Apple will also release a battery cover specifically intended for this model. It will not be included in the box, but you may buy it as an add-on from Apple. This is where things get very frightening. Both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max feature a 48 megapixel telephoto camera with eight times optical zoom and 8K video recording capabilities. Yes, iPhones will support 8K video recording. While few TVs are already 8K capable, Apple is obviously pressing ahead with this major upgrade. The Pro variants will be the only ones to use the Apple A19 Pro chipset. iPhone 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max. Both of these will have 12 GB of RAM. The processor will not be present on the iPhone 17 Air. Due to the ultra-thin design, it will most likely use the standard A19 chipset. Another significant innovation is a vapor cooling chamber, which will be included in both the Pro and Pro Max variants to aid thermal management and performance. The battery sizes have also been given. The iPhone 17 Pro will use a 3,700 mAh battery, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max will have a massive 5,000 mAh battery. The iPhone 17 Air will have a lower 2,800 mAh battery, while the conventional iPhone 17's battery capacity will remain same from last year. The iPhone 17 Air will be available in three colors: light gold, sky blue, and light blue. The Pro models, as expected, will get two new colors, orange and deep blue. So with that been said, let me know your thoughts in the comment below. If you are new here, please subscribe. Peace out.

title: Europe's car giants fight back at the Munich motor show
transcription: The European car industry is fighting battles on several fronts. At home, there's red tape. In America, there's Tesla and tariffs, and of course, there's China, the rising force in the automotive industry. Big European motor shows used to be a celebration of the local car industry, featuring iconic brands and the people who'd lead them. Now, companies like BYD have crashed the party, joined by the likes of Deepal and Xpeng, the latter set up here right next door to Volkswagen. Here's how Europe is fighting back. VW's big news at the IAA Auto show in Munich surrounds a line of affordable compact EV similar in size to the Volkswagen Polo. You'll see them wearing the colors of a few brands, including Cupra and Skoda. Its big brother Audi unveiled a new era of design anchored by the sporty concept C, which is set to go into production as a spiritual successor to the Audi TT. Porsche flirted with a camouflaged electric KN featuring wireless charging, but stuck to its guns with a new generation of the iconic 911 Turbo. Over at Mercedes, an all-electric GLC rings in a new era of design for the brand, both inside and out. And AMG showed off its record-breaking XX concept that will be the basis for an upcoming electric performance car. BMW anchored the show with this, the new IX3. We're going to see these in Australia next year, and they are very impressive machines. This one has more than 800 km of driving range. It has more than 340 kW of power, and it has a revolutionary approach to exterior design and interior design that really does shake up the way that you will interact with your next car. These things are magnificent. All of these cars are impressive. But are they enough to help the European car industry win the battles that it is fighting? I don't really know. But one thing's for sure. It's sure not going down without a fight.

title: Event-based Vision Sensor (EVS) - Detecting Changes in Moving Subjects [Technology] | Sony Official
transcription: The human eye is designed to see change. The human optic nerve does not process everything that can be seen, yet is designed to perceive changes in brightness very effectively. It is based on how the optic nerve processes information, and it records only the change in brightness. A new type of machine eye that realizes rapid and large-scale information processing. That's Sony's EVS, Event-Based Vision Sensor. With an event-based vision sensor, how do we capture moving subjects? Let's take a look. With conventional frame-based sensors, all pixel information is recorded in each frame. On the other hand, an event-based vision sensor reacts to pixels with luminance change by the movement of the subject. recognizing the change as an event. Coordinates, time, and light and dark polarities are combined as its output data for the reacting pixel. As a result, compared to frame-based sensors, Sony's event-based vision sensor can achieve high speed and high temporal resolution. It enables advanced data analysis that cannot be achieved under frame-based systems. Let's look at the pixel that outputs the event with Sony's event-based vision sensor. Pixel unit that receives light and brightness change detection unit are connected via copper pads and directly stacked top to bottom. This is Sony's copper copper connection technology. That makes it possible to increase the aperture ratio without any loss. In the entire sensor surface, reduction of circuit area contributes to the low latency. If the size is the same as a conventional frame-based sensor, both high resolution and high sensitivity can be achieved. and also capturing the change according to the rate of change in brightness. The sensor captures the subject with high dynamic range from low to high illuminance. This is Sony's event-based vision sensor.

questions.question: What is the primary difference in how a conventional frame-based sensor and Sony's Event-Based Vision Sensor process information?
questions.answer: A conventional frame-based sensor records all pixel information in each frame, while Sony's Event-Based Vision Sensor only records data for pixels that detect a change in brightness, processing these changes as individual "events".

questions.question: According to the audio, what specific data is outputted when the Event-Based Vision Sensor detects a change?
questions.answer: When an event is detected, the sensor outputs the pixel's coordinates, the time of the event, and the light and dark polarity (i.e., whether the brightness increased or decreased).

These let you zoom in on buildings, find specific departments, and plan your walking route. You can also download PDF maps that show building numbers and nearby parking areas. Since Harvard is in Cambridge, just across the Charles River from Boston, transit maps are helpful too. Boston's Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority provides detailed maps of bus routes and the subway system, especially the red line that stops at Harvard Square. These transit maps help you plan your trip from Boston to Harvard easily. If you want a physical keepsake, printed maps of Harvard's main campus and Harvard Square are available for purchase online or at local stores. These maps often show the Charles River, Harvard Yard and surrounding streets, giving you a broader view of the area. You can also find helpful maps at Boston visitor centers, Cambridge tourist information points, and right at Harvard Square. These often include walking guides, campus highlights and transit tips. To sum up, if you want maps for visiting Harvard University, start with Harvard's official website for detailed campus and business school maps. Use Boston's transit maps to plan your route from Boston to Harvard. And consider getting printed maps for easy reference during your visit. These resources will make your trip smoother and more enjoyable, helping you explore one of the most iconic campuses near Boston.

title: THESE Settings Will Instantly Boost Graphics on your PS5!
transcription: In this video, I'm going to walk you through how to get the best performance out of your PS5 and actually make it run like a beast. I'll show you how to reduce input lag, get better graphics, smoother response times and FPS, and an overall better gaming experience. A lot of players have been searching for ways to squeeze the most out of their console, so today, I'll share a few simple tweaks that really make a difference. Hopefully, you'll find at least a few of these tips useful. As always, don't forget to drop a like and let's get started. So, the first and probably the biggest improvement you can make comes down to your display. Having a modern TV or monitor that supports HDMI 2.1 and features like VRR or 120Hz refresh rates is a game changer. The standard cable that comes with the PS5 works perfectly fine for this, but if you're using a different cable, just make sure it's HDMI 2.1 at least. Next, head into your PS5 settings. Under Game Default presets, switch over to performance mode. Then, go to video output and make sure ALLM or Auto low latency mode is enabled. Set variable refresh rate to automatic and confirm that the 120 Hz option is turned on. Higher frame rates and refresh rates mean less input delay and a much smoother feel overall. Even these changes alone can significantly boost your PS5's performance assuming your display can handle it. Now, even if you don't have a newer HDMI 2.1 compatible screen, don't worry. Just setting your PS5 to performance mode and enabling game mode on your TV will still give you a noticeable improvement. Also, you want to double check that the resolution set on your PS5 actually matches your display's native resolution, as sometimes setting the resolution to automatic actually messes with the colors. And a quick tip that I've found to be really useful is if you're experiencing lag and stutters, and if your resolution is set to 4K in settings, you might want to try and lower it to 1440p or even 1080p. This actually makes your PS5 GPU use less power on the resolution and focus more on FPS. Now, another area where players notice issues is controller input delay. While the DualSense controller works great over wireless, you can switch the communication method to wired if you ever run into inconsistencies. Depending on the game, you can also lower your thumbstick dead zone sensitivity, which is a handy trick to reduce any lag you might feel. And speaking of input and controls, one thing that's made my setup even smoother is using the PS5's Echokey keyboard for Gamescup. It snaps right onto your controller and gives you a quick access to a full keyboard, making it so much easier to type messages, enter codes, or chat with friends without slowing down your gameplay. Honestly, it's a game changer for anyone that hates typing letter by letter with the PS5's controller. I'm going to leave the link down below if you want to check it out, but that's basically it. It really is that straightforward. Follow these steps carefully and your PS5 will be fully optimized. If you found this video useful, make sure to like the video, subscribe, and hit the bell so you don't miss future tips.

title: All-New 2025 Volkswagen | Full Review & First Look
transcription: The year 2025 is shaping up to be a turning point for Volkswagen. For decades, the brand has been known for building reliable, stylish, and practical cars, but this year, they've gone all in on combining tradition with the future of driving. The new Volkswagen models carry a sharper, bolder design language. The body lines are more aerodynamic, the grille has been redesigned with a sleeker finish, and the LED headlights are slimmer, giving the car a futuristic edge. Even the wheel designs have been updated to stand out. So whether it's a hatchback, SUV, or electric model, the presence on the road feels stronger than ever. Step inside, and the changes are even more dramatic. Volkswagen has created interiors that truly feel like stepping into the future. The dashboard is dominated by large digital displays that flow seamlessly into one another, replacing the clutter of buttons we used to see in older models. The infotainment system is now AI driven, which means it learns your habits over time, like what kind of music you prefer in the morning commute or the routes you take most often. The materials feel premium, from soft-touch leather and brushed metal to eco-friendly trims in the electric models. It's designed to feel both luxurious and practical, with enough space and comfort to keep every passenger happy. Performance is where Volkswagen is giving drivers real choice in 2025. For those ready to embrace the future, the fully electric ID lineup has been expanded, offering longer range and faster charging. Some models now reach over 300 miles on a single charge, and with new DC fast charging, you can top up the battery much quicker than before. But Volkswagen hasn't forgotten the traditionalists. There are still updated turbocharged engines and hybrids available. These deliver smoother acceleration, better fuel efficiency, and a refined driving experience that feels connected to the road. Safety is another area that has seen a massive upgrade. The 2025 Volkswagen models come loaded with smart technology like adaptive cruise control, lane centering, blind spot detection, and even predictive systems that anticipate dangers before they happen. It's almost like having a co-pilot who's always looking out for you, making every drive feel more secure. What really makes the 2025 Volkswagen stand out is how it balances everything, style, comfort, performance, and technology, without losing its identity. For drivers who want to step into the future without giving up the reliability and character Volkswagen has always been known for, this is a lineup that delivers. It's more than just transportation, it's about making every drive smarter, safer, and more enjoyable. So when you look at the 2025 Volkswagen, you're not just seeing another new car on the road. You're seeing a vision of where driving is headed, a mix of electric innovation and classic engineering that proves Volkswagen is ready for the next era.

Developed with Fnatic, one of the world's most successful e-sports teams, these pro-level headphones deliver exceptional sound and an unbelievably comfortable design. Perfect for professional tournaments, all-day streaming, or everyday gaming when you need to play at your best. The headphones give you clear performance focused sound straight out of the box, but when connected to a PC with the supplied USBC audio box, you get even more control. Whether you're competing in tournaments or streaming for hours, the Inzone E9 is built for extreme comfort, even during the longest sessions. The fear that a woke AI or a sprawling Earth-based government could simply follow humanity to Mars, has apparently tempered his view of the red planet as a political escape hatch, complicating his once clear-cut futuristic narrative. This grand vision isn't just talk. Musk has dedicated his wealth, estimated at over 335 billion dollars earlier this year, to making this happen. title: LA crews halt hillside fire threat
transcription: About a quarter acre of heavy brush burned uphill near the 2,100 block of North Sunset Plaza Drive, threatening several homes above the fire. The Los Angeles Fire Department dispatched roughly 80 personnel, supported by helicopters and hand crews. Aerial water drops significantly slowed the blaze's advance toward residences. Initial reports indicated a vehicle fire that spread into medium heavy brush toward a hillside home. Mutual aid air and ground units from LA County Fire also responded. By evening, crews had extinguished all active flames and stopped the fire's forward progress. Helicopters continued water drops between homes to cool hotspots, while hand crews worked uphill on steep terrain aiming for full containment. Ground crews prioritized structure defense for the at-risk houses. Authorities issued shelter in place orders for Genesis zones LFDO817, LFDO819 and LFDO911. No civilian injuries were reported. Separately that morning, a two-story house on the 10,300 block of North Christine Place in Chatsworth caught fire after flames were observed on the first floor and spreading toward the rear. About 37 firefighters initiated an immediate offensive. The blaze was reported knocked down by 11:39 a.m. with around 53 personnel handling suppression, overhaul and scene stabilization. All occupants were evacuated and accounted for. One firefighter suffered a minor burn and was treated at the scene. City departments collaborated on the incident. The Department of Water and Power handled utilities, transportation managed traffic disruptions and building and safety conducted structural assessments. Motorists were urged to seek alternate routes due to congestion. Officials credited rapid multi-agency response, aggressive firefighting and aerial support with preventing greater property loss and injuries. Crews remained on scene working hotspots and containment.

title: 2026 NEW BMW VISION CE UNVEILED!! THE WORLD’S FIRST HELMET-FREE ELECTRIC SCOOTER?!
transcription:
At the IAA Mobility 2025 Munich event, BMW Motorad introduced the Vision CE, an electric scooter concept that is truly different from most. Just imagine, riders won't need to wear helmets or protective jackets anymore. The secret lies in the inherent safety structure at the heart of its design. An idea that BMW actually tried more than 25 years ago.
Its history began in 2000 with the BMW C1, a unique scooter featuring a roof, roll cage, and seatbelt. Although not mass-produced, the C1 has a loyal following who prioritize comfort over the classic scooter style. Two decades later, BMW succeeded with the CE04 and CE02, two electric scooters that proved eco-friendly mobility can still be stylish. Now, Vision CE brings the C1 legacy, but in a modern format with proven electric technology. The most striking feature of the Vision CE is the safety cell. A metal alloy tube frame with custom seats and seatbelts. This system is designed to provide protection like a small car cabin, so helmets are no longer mandatory. This approach could be a solution to two major obstacles for two-wheeled commuters, the hassle of wearing gear and feeling hot in warm weather. From a design perspective, the Vision CE appears long, low, and futuristic. The safety frame is lightweight and open, more like an architectural framework than a cage. The chosen colors are simple yet elegant. Matte white combined with black, with neon red accents that give a modern and technical feel. The exposed aluminum details add a sense of robustness, while the matte seats and fine lettering keep the look minimalist. Another interesting feature is the self-balancing technology, which keeps the scooter upright even when stopped. Practical at red lights, easy for beginners, and provides a greater sense of stability. Technically, the Vision CE is based on the BMW CE04, which has 42 horsepower and a range of up to 130 km. Indeed, adding a safety frame can increase weight and slightly reduce performance, but BMW emphasizes that this scooter is specifically designed for short-distance urban travel. Although it's still a concept, BMW is known for often bringing ideas from the Vision CE into production. If it's truly marketed, the production version will likely add an aerodynamic roof for weather protection while also reinforcing the helmet-free claim. This combination of safety, comfort, and efficiency has the potential to attract more city commuters, even those who were previously reluctant to ride motorcycles due to inconvenience or risk.

title: FIRST LOOK - iPhone 17 Pro Max Hands On Review!
transcription: We are just a few days away from the next iPhone event, which is scheduled for September 9th. While there are many rumors, we do have some verifiable details about the iPhone 17 Pro variants. The first is the revival of aluminum. If you are currently utilizing an iPhone 15 or 16, this suggests you are using a titanium made iPhone. While titanium is extremely durable, it is much more expensive and heavier than aluminum. This year, Apple is reportedly returning to aluminum. They're doing this to save money, and using aluminum will make the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max lighter. The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max will also see an increase in battery life. For example, the Pro Max model will feature a 5,000 milliamp hour battery, putting it on level with Android competition. However, a larger battery implies more weight, which is why Apple is employing aluminum this year to make the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max variants lighter and more comfortable to carry. While we don't know exactly how durable these new iPhones will be, only time will tell. The second item you should consider is the redesigned back design. For the first time in years, the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max variants will feature a fresh back design. This means that a massive camera bar will be there on the back. And it's not just for looks. It'll also aid to accommodate the spanking new 48 megapixel periscope zoom camera. This zoom camera will allow Apple to challenge Samsung's dominance in the camera zoom industry. Official cases for these iPhones were also leaked, revealing the identical leak back design as the next iPhones. It is predicted that the camera will have up to 8x optical zoom. Once again, this will be optical rather than digital zoom. Thus the quality will be excellent even at 8x zoom. The third thing to bear in mind is the announcement of the iPhone 17 Air. While the pro models will remain unchanged from prior years, Apple is discontinuing the 17 plus model and instead introducing the iPhone 17 Air. This will be a significantly thinner smartphone, with the sole drawback being the battery life. The battery will be less than 3,000 milliamp hours. So, if you like ultra thin phones, you might want to try the iPhone Air. So without been said, let me know your thoughts in the comment below. If you are new here, please subscribe. Peace out.

title: Where Was Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon Filmed? - China Cultural Expedition
transcription:
Where was Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon filmed?
Have you ever wondered where the breathtaking scenes of Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon were captured? This iconic film, directed by Ang Lee, is a beautiful representation of Chinese culture and cinema. It takes us back to early 19th-century imperial China, showcasing stunning landscapes and intricate artistry.
The film was primarily shot in China, utilizing a mix of natural beauty and elaborate sets. One of the most notable locations is the Huangshan region in Anhui province. This area is famous for its dramatic granite peaks and lush pine forests, creating a striking backdrop for many scenes. The unique scenery adds depth to the film, making it visually captivating.
Another key filming site is the Anji Bamboo Forest in Zhejiang province. This serene forest is known for its lush bamboo groves, providing a tranquil environment that perfectly complements the film's more peaceful moments. The beauty of this location truly enhances the film's aesthetic.
Beijing, the capital city of China, also played a role in the filming process. The urban landscape of Beijing contributed to the cultural aspects of the story, showcasing the blend of tradition and modernity in Chinese life.
Chengde, located in Hebei province, was another filming location. This city offers a mix of historical and natural settings, which helped to create the film's rich visual narrative. The combination of these diverse locations allowed the filmmakers to capture the essence of Chinese culture.
Additionally, Hengdian World Studios in Zhejiang province was utilized for creating elaborate sets. As the largest film studio in the world, it provided the facilities needed to recreate traditional Chinese architecture and settings. This studio played a vital role in bringing the film's story to life.
Together, these locations contributed to the film's success, highlighting China's rich cultural heritage and stunning natural beauty. Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon is not just a film. It is a celebration of Chinese arts and performing arts, making it a significant part of Chinese cinema history. Each location, from the majestic mountains to the serene bamboo forests, adds to the film's enchanting narrative, leaving a lasting impression on audiences worldwide.

title: Germany's Deutsche Bahn in deep trouble | Lars Halter Reports
transcription: When you think of Germany, you think of cars and the autobahn, the country's famed highway system. But in an effort to lower carbon emissions, Berlin wants more people to switch to rail for traveling. Except the German rail provider is in dire straits. Lars Holter is with Deutsche Welle and joins me from Berlin now. Lars, thank you for being with us. What can you tell us about the current situation? Thanks for having me. Indeed, the Deutsche Bahn, as the rail provider is called, is in deep trouble and has actually been in deep trouble for many years. The company's infamous for delays and disruptions, but right now, the biggest concern is that the company doesn't even have leadership. Technically, of course, there is a CEO in charge right now, but he's been fired a few days ago by the government. That is because Deutsche Bahn is not really a private company. It is set up pretty much like a regular company, but it's fully state-owned. So the new government, frustrated with how business is going at the Bahn, stepped in. They told the CEO that his time will be over, but only once they found a successor. The problem is, so far, no one has been found. Apparently, some top managers were asked, but politely declined the offer. And meanwhile, the lame duck CEO is likely not very motivated to lead any longer. Lars, so what are the options for future here? What's going to happen to the German railroad? Well, the company needs a strategy for the future, that's for sure. But maybe it also needs competition. In Italy, they had very similar problems a few years ago, but ever since the state-owned rail provider there got competition from a private company using the same tracks, of course, things did actually improve. Trains got more punctual, prices are down. So maybe that's an idea to copy. Of course, the German system still needs a lot of work on its infrastructure, but it also needs to change its perspective and keep a closer eye on customer's needs. And for that, actually, one analyst recently had another idea, a small change to the perks for any new CEO, and that would be that he should not get a chauffeured business car any longer. The idea was to make the CEO take his own trains every day for short and long distances, so that at least he can experience how bad things really are, and hoping that it will change his perspective and actually help improve things. Thank you, Lars. Lars Holter there reporting from DW Berlin.

title: What Is The Rio De Janeiro International Film Festival? - We Go To Festivals
transcription: What is the Rio de Janeiro International Film Festival? Have you ever wondered what makes the Rio de Janeiro International Film Festival so special? This festival, also known as Festival do Rio, is Brazil's largest film festival and one of the most significant events in Latin America. It started in 1999 when two earlier festivals merged to create a more streamlined event. The Rio Cine Festival, which began in 1984, and the Mostra Banco Nacional de Cinema, founded in 1988, combined to avoid scheduling conflicts and make the festival experience better for everyone. Festival do Rio takes place in the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro. Each year, it showcases a diverse selection of films, typically featuring over 350 films from more than 60 countries. You can expect to see a wide range of genres, including feature films, documentaries, and short films. The atmosphere at the festival is warm and inviting, making it a great place to enjoy both international films and a broad spectrum of Latin American cinema. One of the standout sections of the festival is called Premiere Brasil. This part focuses specifically on Brazilian cinema and is quite competitive. It features a significant number of Brazilian films, including fiction, documentaries, and shorts. This section provides a fantastic platform for local filmmakers to present their work to both local and international audiences. Attendees often have the chance to meet filmmakers and actors, which adds to the festival's charm. The audience also gets to vote for the best films in various categories, while an official jury awards the festival's main prizes, including the coveted Redentor trophy. The festival is held across multiple cinemas in Rio de Janeiro, making it accessible to a broad audience. In addition to film screenings, Festival do Rio often includes debates, special sessions, and lectures. These events contribute to the cultural and audiovisual development of the city. The festival plays a vital role in strengthening Rio's position in the audiovisual sector and promoting Brazilian culture on both national and international stages. Overall, the Rio de Janeiro International Film Festival is a major cultural event that celebrates cinema, supports local filmmakers, and connects audiences with both global and regional film production. If you are a film enthusiast or just curious about cinema, this festival is definitely worth checking out.

title: Burning Man 2025: The Desert’s Greatest Festival of Fire & Freedom
transcription: Each year in late August, Nevada's Black Rock Desert transforms into a temporary city called Black Rock City. What began in 1986 as a small bonfire gathering on a San Francisco beach is now a global cultural phenomenon. Today, over 70,000 people arrive with tents, bicycles, and art, building a community from nothing but dust. Burning Man isn't just a festival. It's a community shaped by 10 guiding principles: radical inclusion, self-reliance, and self-expression among them. Participants wear futuristic costumes, glittering masks, and LED lights. Strangers become friends, and the desert becomes a place of freedom, creativity, and unity. The playa is a living art gallery. Giant wooden temples tower over the desert floor. Mechanical dragons breathe fire, and surreal neon structures glow against the night sky. Art cars, transformed into moving sculptures, carry dancers and lights through the dust. Everything here is created by participants, and nothing is left behind. From sunrise yoga and meditation to all-night raves, Burning Man pulses with sound and movement. DJs spin under laser beams, drummers pound in circles, and fire spinners light up the night. The energy is raw and electric, a celebration of music, creativity, and life itself in the middle of the desert. At the festival's peak, the Man, a towering wooden effigy, is set ablaze in front of tens of thousands. Flames rise, sparks scatter across the desert sky, and cheers echo through the playa. Another sacred fire consumes the temple, a space for reflection and remembrance. And then, just as quickly, Black Rock City disappears, leaving only dust, memories, and the spirit of Burning Man.

title: Rare 1933 Footage of the Last Tasmanian Tiger | Colourised by NFSA
transcription: Once upon a time, in the wild landscapes of Tasmania, lived the thylacine, also called the Tasmanian tiger for the dark stripes across its back. Despite its wolf-like face, the thylacine was actually a marsupial, carrying its young in a pouch, just like kangaroos. It was the largest carnivorous marsupial of modern times, a shy and nocturnal hunter that fed on small animals and birds. Unlike dogs or wolves, its jaw could open to an astonishing 80 degrees, giving it a fearsome bite. Sadly, European settlers saw the thylacine as a threat to sheep and livestock. By the late 1800s, there were even government bounties that encouraged hunting. Disease, habitat loss, and competition with dogs only made things worse. The last known thylacine lived in Beaumaris Zoo in Hobart. Filmed in 1933 by naturalist David Fleay, it died just three years later, in 1936. That moment marked the end of a species that had survived for thousands of years. Today, the thylacine remains a powerful symbol of extinction and a reminder of the importance of protecting endangered wildlife before it's too late.

transcription: This is the new Pixel Watch 4. It's got a great new design with a 10% larger display and some great new AI features powered by Gemini. Let's take a deeper look. Inside, the Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 is not only 25% faster, but it's more efficient, making the most out of the 455 mAh battery. Google claims that the 41 mm model will last up to 30 hours on a single charge, while the 45 mm model can last up to 40 hours. So, if you're out of the range of a cell phone tower, you'll still be able to call for help. The watch will send a text and your coordinates to emergency responders. And what device these days wouldn't be complete without AI? When it comes to price and availability, the 41 mm model starts at 349 and the 45 mm version starts at 3.99. So the new Pixel Watch 4 has a great design that's a lot better than the predecessor, and it has better battery life, too, which I can't wait to try out. I'm also interested to check out all the new AI features. It should make it a lot more useful to people on the go. So are you going to be picking up a Pixel Watch 4? Let us know in the comments. title: Second child drowns at Billy Dunlop Park; Clarksville closes park until further notice
transcription: A second child has now died. This is just a few months within the last few months there at the Billy Dunlap Park. This is over in Clarksville. This morning, we're trying to figure out exactly who's responsible for making sure that it does not happen for a third time. Fox 17 News Madeleine Nolan joins us live right now with the answers she's been able to get so far. Yes, good morning. I am here outside of Billy Dunlap Park. And as you can tell, it is closed off and it is closed off indefinitely after this latest tragedy. The city of Clarksville admits that this is a natural area along the Red River where water conditions can change quickly and become pretty dangerous. Signs are posted at the park warning of swift currents, drop-offs, low visibility, debris, and even wildlife. Now they do urge visitors to always wear a flotation device on some of those signs, but despite all of these warnings, two children have now been pulled from these water in just two months. The city says that they are heartbroken and has temporarily closed Billy Dunlap Park, but emphasizes that visitors must take these warnings seriously. Neighbors and family members though say that more may need to be done, whether it's stronger restrictions, enforcement, or even new safety measures. For now, again, this park is shut down until further notice while they do review safety at all of their other parks here in the city of Clarksville. Reporting live in Nash or in Clarksville, I'm Madeleine Olen, Fox 17 News, your Code Red station. Madeleine, I know you've been making a lot of phone calls on this story. Have you been able to find out whether this is part of perhaps a bigger trend? Well, I did ask that question to Clarksville Fire and Rescue and they say while water emergencies um are often common in the summer months, they do not say that this is part of a wider trend. title: Apple’s Vision Pro Has Little to Watch
transcription: It's interesting because they have this hardware. Now it is expensive and heavy, right? But they don't have a ton of software for it. Is that the case? Yeah, that's right. And you know, taking a step back, we've never seen Apple launch a major new product category that they've spent nearly a decade and nearly 10 billion dollars developing, sort of flop like this, right? The Apple Watch was a little slow out the gate, but pretty quickly within a year or several months, it started to go mainstream. Uh the iPod quickly went mainstream, uh the iPhone ticked up pretty quickly, the iPad was a blockbuster out the gate. Uh so this is going slower than I think even Apple anticipated to some degree. The best feature on the headset to your point is the immersive video content, some of the stuff we're showing on the on the display right now. But it's very limited. They have a few series, they only have a few episodes for each of those. They've only released 27 pieces of immersive content in the last year and a half. and it's a conundrum. It's very expensive to make, but why invest all that money in it if the headset's not selling well. On the other hand, that's why people would buy the headset because of that immersive content. So they're a little stuck here. Well, I mean there's only um so many hours of entertainment I can get out of like a dinosaur or Bono, right? So, um, why don't they either make more content for this thing or put it on hold until they're really ready to sell a product we need or can use? Well, here's the thing. Let's say the Vision Pro line doesn't take off for another two years. In 2027, they're going to release a much lighter, completely revamped cheaper version. So if they put out a bunch of content now and pile up all the content now, by the time people actually start using the platform, right, in two, three years from now, all that content is going to be outdated. They're going to refresh the Vision Pro in the next several weeks here, right before the end of this year, with a faster processor and a new strap. That's going to make it faster, more capable for applications, probably improve immersive video content, improve 3D video. It's going to make it feel a bit lighter when you're wearing it on the head. This is going to be table stakes for all the tech companies within the next three to five years. Google's working on this, Samsung's working on this, uh and Apple has been working on this for several years. You know, the original concept for a headset for Apple was glasses. title: Dr.AI: COMPUTEX 2025 Best Choice Award Winner – Full Feature Showcase
transcription: In a major milestone for AI-powered healthcare, Dr. AI has just won the 2025 Computex Best Choice Award in digital healthcare. Designed for healthcare professionals, Dr. AI revolutionizes clinical workflows from hospital check-ins to post-consult summaries, streamlining inpatient and outpatient care with real-time AI tools. At the heart of this innovation is MedPA Medical Pre-assessment, a physician avatar system that lets patients speak to an AI doctor before entering the consultation room. Their symptoms are instantly transcribed into SOAP notes and sent directly to the physician's workstation. In the consultation room, physicians no longer need to manually document notes. With real-time speech-to-text STT, Dr. AI's SOAP Quick Note captures conversations and instantly generates structured SOAP medical records, saving time and improving accuracy. Dr. AI is already in use across major hospitals, clinics, and health examination centers in Taiwan, with the integration underway to scale nationwide. Expansion is also progressing into Japan, Korea, Singapore, and the Middle East. As the winner of the Computex Digital Healthcare Award, Dr. Clarence Liao stated. Dr. AI is designed to reduce clinical burden, support borderless care, and innovate the global standard of AI in healthcare. At Computex, Dr. AI also unveiled its next leap, the Dr. AI Smart Ring, a wearable AI doctor offering health insights and consultations anytime, anywhere. And it doesn't stop there. With the launch of Vet AI, the platform is bringing medical-grade AI to 24/7 pet care. From hospital to home, and even your pet, Dr. AI is redefining the future of smart healthcare.

title: Where Was The Wolf Man Filmed? - Famous Movies Club
transcription:
Where was the Wolfman filmed?
If you are curious about the filming locations of the classic horror film, The Wolf Man, from 1941, you are in for an interesting journey. This iconic movie was primarily filmed at Universal Studios in Universal City, California. The studio backlot played a vital role in bringing the eerie atmosphere to life. One of the key sets used was the Court of Miracles, which provided the perfect backdrop for the film's chilling scenes. The production team took full advantage of the controlled studio environment to create the Gothic look that fans remember so well. They constructed detailed sets that included a village, a farm, and the interiors of the Talbot family estate. And like many modern films that often utilize various outdoor locations, the Wolfman relied heavily on Universal Studio resources. This approach was common for classic universal monster movies of that era. transcription: Apple's iPhone 17 is just around the corner, and I know what you're probably thinking. How much is this thing going to cost me? And if that happens, prices won't just go up a little, they'll jump. Think about it. With the rumored $50 bump, the Air could hit $949, but some insiders think it might push past $1,000 because of its slim premium design. Now, here's the part that stings a little. While Apple seems ready to raise prices, Samsung didn't do that with the Galaxy S25. Google also looks set to keep Pixel 10 pricing mostly the same. So, in a way, Apple's the odd one out here. But, and this is a big but, Apple isn't just raising prices for no reason. The base iPhone 17 is finally getting a 120 Hz display, which means everything you do on it will feel smoother. The Pro models are expected to bring a crazy new 48 megapixel periscope camera with up to 10x zoom and even 8K video. And the Air, that design could be a real show stopper. The iPhone 17 lineup probably won't come cheap. But when you look at the upgrades, it's not just a price hike, it's Apple raising the bar once again. Finally, what are your thoughts about it? This is exactly what we're going to build together today, an Airbnb auto-reply WhatsApp chatbot using only WhatsBolt, no official WhatsApp API needed. Once we've linked our WhatsApp account, we can create our chatbot by selecting the WA chatbot option. Now, let's select the profile where we want to set up the chatbot and click on add item. I've created a document with all the keywords and their respective answers for our Airbnb chatbot, covering details like check-in, check-out, Wi-Fi, and more. We'll keep the status enabled. For not matching default response, choose yes. Then, set recipient type to individual, since we don't want this chatbot replying in group conversations. For type, it doesn't matter in this case because this will be our default response. Give your chatbot a name and a short description. Keywords aren't important in this step, so you can just type any keyword. For presence delay, set it to 3 seconds and enable show typing. This makes it feel like a real person is responding. Hover your mouse over this area and you'll spot the share button. Give it a click. This button is where the magic truly happens as it opens up options that allow you to either share screen or share window. If you want the greatest degree of versatility while presenting, opt for the share screen choice. This option provides you with the freedom to seamlessly switch between your PowerPoint presentation and any other applications you might need during the meeting. And for those of you with multiple monitors, it's important to select the screen that contains your PowerPoint. Now, here's a pro tip. The emotional weight of teaching can be just as heavy. From managing classroom dynamics to supporting students mental health. It can feel like we are carrying the weight of our students' emotions on our shoulders. And then there's the weight of expectations from administrators, parents, and even ourselves. There's a constant pressure to perform, to achieve, and to meet standards. It can feel like we are being pulled in a million different directions, all the while trying to stay true to our values as teachers. But what if we could find a way to lighten the load? To prioritize our tasks, to delegate responsibilities, and to seek support from our colleagues. By taking care of ourselves, both physically and emotionally. We can build the resilience we need to carry the weight of our job. We can find joy in teaching again and make a meaningful difference in the lives of our students. Remember, you're not alone in carrying the weight of the world. Teachers, let's work together to find ways to lighten this load, prioritize our wellbeing, and thrive in our roles as teachers. So dear educators, take care and wishing you good times from Ask Meena teacher.

title: FIRST LOOK: iPhone 17 Pro Max Hands-On Review!
transcription: In the world of smartphones, there's slim, and then there's Apple slim. This year, the tech giant is reportedly preparing to unveil its thinnest iPhone ever, the iPhone 17 Air, a device so slender it could almost vanish into your pocket at just 5.5 mm thick. It's a bold statement in design, a featherweight champion in the palm of your hand. But here's the catch, making a phone this thin often comes with a price. And according to reliable leaks, Apple may be trimming more than just the edges. At the heart of the iPhone 17 Air lies a special version of Apple's latest A19 Pro chip, the same powerhouse expected in the Pro and Pro Max models. Almost. The difference? One less GPU core. That might seem small, and for everyday scrolling, streaming, or texting, you probably won't notice. But push it with 3D gaming or heavy video editing, and the performance gap could become clear. Then there's the heat factor. A thinner body means less space to dissipate heat, increasing the chance of thermal throttling, where your phone slows down to cool off during extended workloads. And of course, a slimmer frame means a smaller battery. Translation, bursts of power, but maybe not the all-day stamina many users demand. The compromises don't stop there. To keep the air ultra thin, Apple is rumored to strip it down to a single rear camera, skip the high refresh rate display, and possibly reduce speaker output to just one channel. It's a list of sacrifices that make the Pro models, or even rival Androids, look more versatile by comparison. And yet, there's an audience for this. People who value elegance over excess. For them, the iPhone 17 Air could be the ultimate expression of Apple's design philosophy, light, minimal, and effortlessly stylish. Still, the question remains, will consumers trade performance, battery life, and features for a sleeker silhouette? When it launches, the iPhone 17 Air won't just be another smartphone. It will be a statement, one that divides opinion between those who see it as the future of ultra thin technology, and those who believe substance should never bow to style. Finally, what are your thoughts about it? So without being said, let me know your thought in the comment below. And if you are new here, please subscribe. Peace out.

title: DJI Mini 5 Pro – Hands-On Images Reveal MAJOR Upgrades!
transcription: We just got our clearest look yet at DJI's next ultra light drone, and it's not just a refresh. New images from well-known leaker Jasper Ellens via Drone XL reveal design changes, hidden tricks borrowed from DJI's newest models and even the release window. If you thought the mini series had peaked, you might want to sit down for this. The leak front-facing shot instantly gives away a few big upgrades. Front and center, a redesigned gimbal housing a one-inch camera sensor. Between the two main lenses, LAR sensors, an addition that hints at smarter obstacle avoidance. Even the motors have been updated, darker in color, but more importantly, compatible with quick release propellers for faster swaps in the field. Flip it over and the changes keep coming. For the first time in a mini series drone, there's a power lead port, just like the Mavic and Air lines. But the real head turner, it's expected to carry a C0 classification, keeping it under the 249g threshold. That means fewer restrictions in most regions without sacrificing performance. One leak shows ducted propeller guards with low noise tips, a design that echoes the DJI flip. The difference? These guards are removable, giving pilots the flexibility to fly light or add protection depending on the environment. This is where the Mini 5 Pro might completely change how people use a travel drone. Leaks suggest a side mounted quick launch button that can send the drone airborne and start recording. No controller required. If that sounds familiar, it's because DJI has already experimented with it on the Neo and the flip, but this will be the first time it lands on a Mini Pro. According to Jasper Ellens, the Fly More Combo with the RC2 controller will land around $1,200. And while DJI hasn't officially confirmed it, insiders are pointing to a September release window. If these leaks hold true, the Mini 5 Pro could be DJI's most versatile sub 250G drone yet, bridging the gap between portability and pro-level shooting. I'll be covering every update as it drops. transcription: Liverpool's center-back plan is taking shape, and the next name on the board is Giovanni Leoni. At just 18, the Parma defender burst onto the Serie A scene last season, earning an Italy U21 call-up and a reputation for ice-cold composure beyond his years. Now, as reports suggest Liverpool are weighing a move, Anfield could become the stage where Leoni levels up from prodigy to Premier League force. Leoni is a modern center-half, aggressive in duels, calm in build-up, and brave enough to split lines under pressure. He steps in front with timing rather than rashness, angles his body to show forwards into traffic, and when he wins it, his first pass is forward. Aerially, he competes, but his standout traits are anticipation and recovery pace, perfect for a high defensive line that lives on front foot pressing. Think, win it early, play it early. Why Liverpool, why now? The Reds want at least one center back before the September 1st deadline. Jarrell Quansa has departed, Joe Gomez is nursing an Achilles issue, and Ibrahima Konate is in the final 12 months of his deal. That left Virgil Van Dijk and Konate as the only senior options for the community shield. Depth is not a luxury. It's a necessity. Leone offers upside today and headroom for tomorrow. title: Berlin protesters challenge the city's century-old 'no swimming rule' | DW News
transcription:
Now summer temperatures are rising here in Berlin, as they are across much of Europe, and with them the need to beat the heat. The area's lakes and pools might be just the thing for some, but they're not where this next group of Berliners is choosing to cool off. 

It's a protest, but without placards, megaphones or angry chants. Instead, Berliners are making their political point in swimsuits. The mission, to paddle away a century-old ban on swimming in central Berlin. 
We ask politicians to lift our ban. It's about time. All the other cities are doing it. Even city like Paris proved that it's possible. Uh, cities in the Ruhr area, former industrial area in the west of, uh, Germany proved it. New York has plans, London has plans. Many other cities are already doing it, and Berlin is really lagging behind.
For 100 years, authorities have said the Spree is too dirty for a dip. But campaigners from the group Flussbad Berlin say that's outdated, thanks to cleaner industry and improved water treatment. They claim the river's often as safe as other city waterways. 
The reason has been the water hygiene for 100 years, and it has been an issue actually. But now, um, in general water quality is much better and more important is we have now uh water monitoring technologies that we can actually foresee what's happening in the water.
Beyond the fun, there's a serious point. Climate change is making Berlin hotter and inner-city rivers could offer a vital way to cool down. So, instead of marching, protesters backstroked, breaststroked, and freestyled their way through the historic heart of Berlin. Their slogan, 100 years of the swimming ban, time to crawl it away. So, will this city finally dive in and lift the ban? That's still up in the air, or perhaps we should say, still up the river.

title: The To Do List Summit Recap - San Francisco
transcription: Hey, it's Kevin, and this is my recap of the To-Do list summit in San Francisco this past weekend. The To-Do list summit is a brand new founder event in San Francisco, hosted by experts who led communications, video, social, and events at Y Combinator and Andreessen Horowitz. I applied, got accepted, booked my flight, and landed in San Francisco Friday night. I explored the city, grabbed amazing Mexican food, and finally, took my first Waymo ride, which was super smooth, futuristic, not cheap, but it was worth it. Saturday kicked off at 8:30 a.m. in downtown San Francisco. It was an intense, all-day experience surrounded by world-class people, past and current YC founders, ambitious builders everywhere. They tried a crazy idea, giving each founder a time slot to record a one-minute video using professional equipment to explain what our startups do and how we solve problems. They recorded over 60 videos. May God bless the souls of the editors who have to put all of that together. One of the crazy things about San Francisco is that you can cross paths with people that you would never meet anywhere else in the world. In between talks, I ran into Gustav Alströmer, a YC group partner, and we spent five minutes going back and forth refining my one-liner for Twintivo, which was completely unexpected, but fun and super helpful. These are my top three takeaways from the summit. The first one is to be super intentional with content. Is it for customers? Is it for investors? Is it for hiring purposes? Each needs its own structure and they want to see something completely different. The second one is that in order to earn the first customers, the winning strategy is to provide value first and then earn the right to pitch the idea. And content is the most affordable and efficient way to provide that value first. And the third one is that consistency is key, but only if the content is consistently high quality. So, from now on, I am only posting what the kids call bangers. The event was flawless. Huge thanks to the awesome team that made the inaugural The To-Do List Summit happen. If you are an early stage founder, keep an eye on theplatformteam.com for future events. Thanks for watching and see you in the next video.

title: How To Tell If Your Steam Deck Is OLED – Model Check, Specs & Display Tips
transcription: Wondering if you have the OLED or LCD Steam deck? There are several key differences that make identification straightforward. The Steam deck OLED was released in November 2023 as a significant upgrade to the original LCD model from 2022. Let's examine the key physical differences that help identify which model you have. First, check the screen bezels. The OLED model has noticeably thinner bezels around the display compared to the LCD version. The OLED model is also slightly lighter, weighing 608 grams compared to the LCD's 638 grams, a 30 gram difference you can feel. OLED models come in standard black and limited edition translucent shells, while LCD models only come in black. Another easy check is the kickstand. OLED models feature an improved, wider kickstand for better stability. If you bought your steam deck after November 2023, there's a high chance it's an OLED, as Valve has discontinued most LCD models, keeping only the 256 gigabyte version. Here's your quick identification checklist. These physical differences make it easy to determine which steam deck model you have. The most definitive way to identify your Steam Deck model is through display and software specifications. The OLED model features significant upgrades that are easy to verify. To check your Steam Deck model through software, navigate to settings, then system, and look for Steam Deck model. This will show you exactly which version you own. Another key identifier is battery capacity. The OLED model has a 50 watt hour battery, while the LCD model has a 40 watt hour battery. This information is visible in the system settings. The easiest way to confirm you have an OLED model is to check your display settings. Look for a 90Hz refresh rate option and HDR settings. Only OLED models support these features. To check for the 90Hz refresh rate, look in your display settings. If you see an option to change the screen refresh rate to 90Hz, you definitely have the OLED model. These simple software checks will definitively identify your steam deck model. Check the system information for model details, look for the 50 watt hour battery capacity and verify the presence of 90 hertz and HDR options in display settings.

title: Malaysians set on fire in Bangkok
transcription: Two Malaysian tourists were critically injured after being set on fire by an unemployed man on Ratchadamri Road, Bangkok on Thursday night. The suspect, a former boxer, believed to have poured thinner on the pair while they were seated on the steps near a shopping center. The two tourists reportedly attempted to escape after being doused with the substance, but the suspect pursued them and subsequently set them on fire. Malaysian Embassy Chargé d'affaires Bong Yik Jui said 26-year-old Ong is in the ICU with serious but non-life-threatening second-degree burns to his upper body, while 27-year-old Gan, who sustained 36% second-degree burns, is stable and conscious. Bong said the embassy has informed the victims' families. The suspect has been identified as a 30-year-old from Sa Kaeo province, who allegedly acted out of frustration over being unemployed. He was caught by members of the public while trying to flee and is now in custody as police continue investigating the motive. Statements will be taken from the victims once they are stable.

title: How Do Product Reviews Compare to Official Appliance Ratings? - Home Appliance Report
transcription: How do product reviews compare to official appliance ratings? Have you ever wondered how product reviews stack up against official appliance ratings? Let's break it down so you can make informed choices when shopping for home appliances. Official appliance ratings come from independent organizations or testing labs. These ratings are created using standardized methods to evaluate appliances. They focus on measurable factors like performance, energy efficiency, durability, and reliability. The testing is consistent across all products in a category, which allows for straightforward comparisons. You can expect detailed data from these ratings, and they are conducted without any influence from manufacturers. This means you receive unbiased and objective information. On the other hand, product reviews, especially those from users or customers, reflected individual experiences with appliances in real-world settings. These reviews can give you a glimpse into everyday use, customer satisfaction, and practical issues like ease of use and noise levels. However, the quality of user reviews can vary widely. Some may be subjective or influenced by personal expectations. You might find reviews that are overly positive or negative, which may not representing the typical experience. Professional review sites and consumer organizations often combine both methods. They conduct their own tests while also considering user feedback. By purchasing appliances as regular customers, they avoid any bias from manufacturers. This results in ratings that are both data-driven and reflective of actual usage. When it comes to home appliances, relying on official ratings helps you understand the technical performance and reliability of a product. Meanwhile, product reviews can highlight real-life advantages or issues that might not show up in lab tests. For instance, you might learn about customer service quality or how well an appliance fits into a typical household environment. So, how can you use this information when choosing home appliances? Start by looking at official ratings to narrow down your options based on objective performance and efficiency. After that, check out product reviews to learn about user experiences, common problems, and satisfaction levels. By combining both sources, you can make a more informed purchase decision that balances technical quality with everyday usability.

questions.answer: Official appliance ratings are based on standardized, objective tests from independent labs focusing on measurable factors like performance and efficiency. In contrast, user product reviews are subjective, reflecting individual, real-world experiences and practical issues like ease of use.

Coach Hansi Flick highly values Torres and wants to keep him in the future. However, the board must decide whether to renew his contract or approve sale offers. The uncertainty surrounding his future generates a debate. Should Barcelona sell Ferran Torres or secure his renewal? In my opinion, the club should prioritize Torres's contract renewal. His performance, versatility, and commitment make him a valuable asset. Selling him now could generate revenue, but losing a rising player could be a long-term mistake, especially if Flick trusts him with his project. Now, let's move on to the surprising news, the possible signing of Xavi Simons to strengthen the midfield. Although no move in this position was expected, the uncertainty surrounding Frenkie de Jong's continued presence, whose contract had not yet been renewed, led Barcelona to consider this option. Xavi Simons, trained at La Masia and currently targeted by the club, could return following negotiations between Deco and his agent. Hansi Flick had already approved this signing, but much of his passion opposed it, arguing that the midfield was well covered by the current players. The question is whether the addition of Xavi Simons would be necessary. In my opinion, this approach would be unnecessary at this time. Barcelona has a solid midfield, with players like Gavi, Pedri, and other young talents who guarantee quality and depth. Simons, although talented, doesn't seem like a priority, especially considering his arrival could limit players' opportunities. Furthermore, the club should focus on resolving pending renewals, such as that of De Jong, before bringing in new players for a new position. title: Talking Shop: Slam City Skates Nike SB Air Max 95
transcription: When I first heard about the uh, 95 coming into S I was like, I actually think the story's a lie. I didn't believe it. I really liked the colorway. I think the pink pop here, like matching the laces, is really sick. London street culture is kind of different. There's a lot of different kind of like sub genres and there's a lot of different styles so you can kind of take influence from each one, you know? This is definitely a uniform for this city. This is, this is what you need when you come to the city I think. I first started personally wearing them when I was a teenager. That was like my go-to shoe for a rave. Because like for heel flips, like obviously you got to put your foot like along the edge of the board. The the toe looks rough. Is that rough? Obviously standing on a skateboard, you know, this part part like wears away really easily. So having a bit more a bit more grip in that, you know, definitely helps. I feel like skateboarding and and sneaker culture borrow from each other a lot. Skateboarders, you're out in the street, you're seeing a spot and you're kind of looking at it in different ways and I feel like that's a very very similar thing to what's happened with the 95 is like, okay, we'll lower the footbed, we'll make it a bit more responsive. The right time to to add the 95s off of Andy's feet to my uh, to my to my collection. Slam has been around for almost 40 years. It means a lot of different things for different people in different timelines. The first time I stepped into Slam City Skates was in Covent Garden. I was like 13, 14. I started skating when I was 14, 15, and then around 16, 17, I was coming to London. I'd come up to like, I got to go to Slam, grab a sticker, slap it on my board, and then when I go back home, everyone be like, "Whoa, you went to Slam!" It's like a safe space. Found out friends had passed away whilst we're in the shop, found out, you know, people getting married, having kids. It was all in this community hub which offers so much more than just a shop. For the younger crowd, it's somewhere where they can go, they can chat about what's going on in skateboarding, but then to the older generation it's like a trip down memory lane. They're like, 'I went to Slam when I was, you know, 15 and that was in like 1992,' and I'm like, 'Bro, I was two years old.' If you walk into my store and you're like, I know nothing about skateboarding, but I want to get into it. That's the best thing for me.

title: NFL Training Camp - Raw Footage 8/6
transcription: I've watched a lot of raw footage from joint practices and teams getting ready for joint practices, and here are my biggest takeaways. It might not sound right, but Russell Wilson and Malik Neighbors are actually getting along pretty well. The two of them have been spending a lot of time together in the meeting rooms and outside of the facilities, and it's showing on the field. Russell Wilson is putting the ball where Malik Neighbors can get it, and Malik Neighbors is always going to go up and get it. Their chemistry is a lot better than people want you to believe, and I think it might actually work out. Who's winning the Colts QB battle? Neither of them. And that is the reason Anthony Richardson's going to start versus the Ravens and Daniel Jones is going to start versus the Packers. They're both going to play in a pre-season game and whoever looks better is going to end up being the starting QB. And if I'm putting my money on one of them, it's going to be Anthony Richardson. Yes, he makes mistakes, but he's also the one who's making the more explosive plays. What's happening at Colts-Ravens joint practice? The Colts defense is actually getting a lot more stops than you would expect against the Ravens offense. Mark Andrews is 100% Lamar Jackson's go-to target. It's not even a question. And Michael Pittman, Josh Downs, and Tyler Warren are going to be your big three receivers for the Colts. Treyveon Henderson might be a three-down back. He's looked excellent in pass protection. He can obviously run the ball, and not only is he catching passes, but he's getting wide open. Meanwhile, Rhamondre Stevenson is fumbling. And speaking of three-down backs, Ashton Genti is not going to be leaving the field for the Raiders. We all know that he's a fantastic runner, but he's actually looked really good in pass protection, and he's already become one of Geno Smith's favorite targets. And I think there is a very high possibility he's touching that ball 25 plus times a game. Bonus tidbit, don't forget about Donte Thorton Jr. He is absolutely tearing up training camp every single day. He is getting more and more work. Shedeur Sanders is gonna be the QB for the Browns in most of the preseason. But that's not what I want to talk about. I don't care if the QB is Joe Flacco or Shedeur. Either way, we are sleeping on David Njoku. This man has been catching so many passes. And I think people forget that he had 64 receptions, 505 yards and five touchdowns last season in just 11 games. And finally, Dolphins training camp is physical as fuck. And I'm telling you right now, I'm 20 minutes from the facilities and it is hot as balls out there. But it don't matter. Tua Tagovailoa is absolutely thriving. He's completing 70% or more of his passes. He is executing on third downs and in the red zone like he doesn't usually do. And he's only thrown one interception in all of training camp. And while I know our defense is going to suck, I'm very high on the Dolphins offense this year. A-bada-bing-bada-boom. Baby.

title: How AI Is Speeding Up Post-Wildfire Reconstruction in California
transcription: Hello, it's Tammy Jerome again. Today we will be talking about the rebuild after the wildfires in Altadena and Pacific Palisades. We tragically keep following the restoration efforts of an entire community that turned into ashes. While the wildfires took place in January this year, wildfire survivors in our burnt down neighborhoods are facing some serious challenges rebuilding their homes. It's taking way too long, longer than expected. But there's something you might not know. AI, artificial intelligence could actually help speed up things. Let me explain. Picture this. Somebody you know lost their home in a wildfire, and then they have to wait months and months just to get through the red tape before being able to rebuild their home. It's heartbreaking and it's frustrating. and a reality for many families here in Los Angeles that lost their homes.
