title: The mighty ocean
transcription: Have you ever wondered what secrets lie deep beneath the ocean's surface? Close your eyes and dive in with me. Splash. You're now swimming in the deep blue sea. But wait, what's that? A shadow is moving fast. It's a dolphin and it wants to race. You try to keep up, but dolphins are the ocean's speed champions. They click, whistle, and laugh, as if they're cheering you on. As you dive deeper, the water gets darker. Something glides past. It's a sea turtle, slow and graceful. She's been swimming for 50 years, and now she's returning to the beach where she was born. Just to lay her eggs. She nods at you, like she remembers something from long ago. Suddenly, the water changes color. Not because of the sun, but because of an octopus. It squirts ink and disappears into the rocks. Wait, did it just change color to match the coral? And did it just open a jar with its arms? That's one smart sea creature. You keep swimming, and then you feel it. A strange, soft glow all around you. Jellyfish. Dozens of them, glowing in the dark like underwater stars. They float gently, silently. Beautiful, but mysterious. Then just when you think nothing could be more magical, you hear a low, distant sound, like a drum beat. Boom. Boom. Boom. A giant shape approaches. It's the blue whale, the biggest animal to ever live. Bigger than any dinosaur. And its heart? The size of a car. You float beside it, feeling very small, but not afraid. Because here in the ocean, everything has its place. And now, you're a part of it too. The ocean is waiting for you. Full of stories, full of wonders. Will you return?

transcription: So those who are waiting for the S25 FE, your first look is finally here. And it's coming from none other than trusted leaker OnLeaks. At first glance, the design might seem unchanged, but there are three key differences compared to the S24 FE. First, the device is noticeably thinner. Reports says it's just 7.4 mm thick, down from 8 mm on the previous model. Second, the bezels are getting slimmer, giving you more screen and a more modern look. And third, the camera design now matches the Galaxy S25 Edge, making the S25 FE look far more premium this time around. So, S25 FE is expected to retain the same 6.7 inch 120 Hz display, but this time it's switching from Dynamic AMOLED to Super AMOLED. That means we're likely looking at up to 2600 nits of peak brightness, making it far more usable in direct sunlight. Now, under the hood, it's almost confirmed that Samsung will go with the Exynos 2400, not the newer 2500, reportedly due to production constraints. Performance on the S24 FE wasn't bad, but the battery life did fall short of the regular S24, even with a bigger battery. That's mainly because it used a tone-down version of the Exynos 2400. So, with the full Exynos 2400 this time, we should see a noticeably boost in battery performance. Finally, closing the gap with the flagship S series. We've also got a selfie camera upgrade, going from 10 megapixel to 12 megapixel, which should improve detail and clarity. Plus, you're getting seven years of OS and security updates. The phone is launching with Android 16 out of the box, which means it could receive updates all the way up to Android 23. Storage wise, the S24 FE already had UFS 3.1 for the 128 gigs model and UFS 4.0 for 256 gigs. That's fast and the S25 FE is expected to continue that trend. Recently Apple announced iOS 26 bringing some major changes. iOS 26 is packed with intelligent experiences, meaningful improvements to the things you do every day, and a new design where we've also refreshed a number of system experiences and apps. However, the Galaxy S25 FE is also coming with One UI 8 straight out of the box. One UI 8 will also bring some major upgrades as well. While the One UI 8 beta is already out, the official release is along with the Z Fold 7 launch. So, S25 FE is expected to launch around October, so there's still time for more solid leaks and confirmation to come true. title: 2026 Tesla Cybertruck – Official Unveil and First Look at the Future of EV Trucks
transcription: Welcome back to New Auto Vibe Review and today we are diving into the futuristic and polarizing 2026 Tesla Cybertruck. With its bold angular design and stainless steel exoskeleton, the Cybertruck looks like it's been dropped straight out of a sci-fi movie. The exterior remains mostly unchanged from the original concept with a raw metal finish that resists dents and corrosion. Tesla now offers optional wrap colors including matte black, stealth gray and satin white for those who want a more refined or personalized look. The front of the Cybertruck is defined by its continuous sled light bar and flat nose with no traditional grill. The armored glass windows are carried over from earlier prototypes, now upgraded for even more durability. The sharp edges and geometric body panels are not just for show, they also contribute to the vehicle's rigidity and aerodynamics. With its high ground clearance and massive wheels, the Cybertruck still dominates visually on and off the road. Inside the 2026 Cybertruck, you get a minimalist cabin with a large central touchscreen and a yoke style steering wheel. The interior seats six with a fold down front center console and features sustainable materials throughout. The Cybertruck offers multiple power drain options with dual and tri motor setups delivering up to 800 horsepower and over 500 miles of range. It can tow up to 14,000 lbs and accelerate from 0 to 60 in under 2.9 seconds. Pricing starts at around $60,000 and can go beyond 90,000 depending on the configuration. Thanks for watching New Auto Vibe review.

title: Dua Lipa on Pedro Almodóvar
transcription: My favorite director, Pedro Almodova. Hola Pedro, como estas? I feel like you're very meticulous in your detail and you bring certain parts of your life into your stories. There's always moments when I, you know, read stories or I watch videos or I watch movies and I go, wow, I wish I lived through that time and that experience when there was so much energy and creativity. I think that's the beauty of it is the kind of punk rock element. As long as you get the story across, as long as you get your message and your point, then that's also the the beauty of the artistry. The first era of your career, as you've called it, was like a response to the end of the Franco regime. You know, I imagine that anybody under the fringes of an authoritarian regime, once they feel like they've been freed, then in a way you can kind of create what you want, be how you want. One of the things that I and many many audiences love about you is the way that you tell stories about women and about queer people going as far back as your first film to tell those sorts of stories when they might have been considered countercultural. I think what I really see is a presentation of a more normalized world is what it or at least what we want a normalized world to be. and the way that it's presented I think is is amazing because the characters never feel like they have to prove something. They just are unapologetically themselves. They arrive fully formed and I think that's really inspiring. And and about the women too, I I feel a deep connection to all of that and the and the stories and you know, you listening to women and seeing how they express themselves. It's very fascinating to me. you know, your movies deal with so many themes, you know, love, sex, politics, family, faith, art. Because I've watched so many of them, I feel like they have many similarities and they all share such common DNA, but I think every single one is quite different, you know, from the last.

title: What Is The Adidas Firebird Tracksuit? - Hip Hop Gurus
transcription: What is the Adidas Firebird tracksuit? Have you ever wondered how a simple tracksuit became a cultural icon in hip-hop fashion? The Adidas Firebird tracksuit is a perfect example of this phenomenon. Originally launched in the 1980s, this tracksuit features the iconic three stripes along the sleeves and pant legs. It evolved from earlier Adidas styles, such as the Beckenbauer tracksuit, and quickly became a symbol of athletic excellence and street style. The Firebird tracksuit typically consists of a zip-up jacket and matching pants made from shiny polyester fabric. This sleek and sporty look made it a favorite among athletes and fashion enthusiasts alike. In hip-hop culture, the Firebird tracksuit holds a special place as a cultural emblem. During the 1980s, it became closely associated with the emerging hip-hop scene, especially among B-boys, MCS, and break dancers. The tracksuit was embraced for its comfort and durability, which suited the dynamic movements of breakdancing and the expressive fashion of hip-hop artists. One of the most significant moments linking the Adidas Firebird tracksuit to hip-hop came from the legendary rap group Run-DMC from Queens, New York. They famously wore the Firebird tracksuit as part of their signature look, pairing it with Adidas Superstar sneakers and gold chains. This image became iconic and helped establish the tracksuit as the unofficial uniform of old-school hip-hop. Run-DMC's 1986 hit, My Adidas, celebrated the brand and its connection to their identity. This song led to the first major endorsement deal between a music group and a sportswear company, marking a turning point in both music and fashion. The Firebird tracksuit's influence extended beyond just fashion. It symbolized authenticity, street credibility, and unity within the hip-hop community. It bridged the gap between sportswear and music culture, making Adidas a staple brand in hip-hop fashion. Even today, the Firebird tracksuit is revered as a retro classic that represents the roots of hip-hop style. It continues to be worn and celebrated by artists and fans alike. The Adidas Firebird tracksuit is more than just athletic wear. It is a cultural icon that helped define hip-hop fashion in the 1980s and remains a symbol of the genre's early style and attitude.

title: How to Set Time & Date on Boat Storm Call 3 Smartwatch (Easy Guide)
transcription: Alright, so here's the deal. Everything looks great, feels nice, but the moment I powered it on, the time and date were totally wrong, like way off. So naturally, I started scrolling through the settings, thinking, okay, maybe it's under system or general or something. But nope, nothing. No option to set the time manually. And if you're watching this video, I'm pretty sure you're in the same boat. You probably tried everything too and just couldn't find where to to set the time on this thing. It's kind of frustrating, right? But but don't worry, I figured it out, and it's actually really simple once you know what to do. So here's the secret, you can't set the time directly from the watch itself. It doesn't work that way. Instead, you have to connect the watch to your phone using the Boat Crest app. That's the official app for this watch. Once you pair it with your phone, the watch will automatically grab the correct time and date from your phone and fix itself. just like that. So, I opened the Boat Crest app. You can get it from the Play Store or the App Store. And once it's open, I selected my watch model, which is the Storm Call 3, then it showed this scanner screen, and at the top right, there's this option that says, pair with Bluetooth. I tapped that and boom. It started showing the name of my smartwatch on the list. I clicked it, it started pairing. And after a few seconds, guess what? The time and date on the watch synced perfectly. It just fixed itself automatically. No extra steps, no headache. And hey, once you're connected, there's a lot more you can do with the Boat Crest app too. You can change watch faces, manage notifications, control music, check your health stats, all the good stuff. But yeah, back to the main point. If your Boat Storm Call 3 is showing the wrong time, don't waste time digging through settings or resetting things like I did. and just pair it with the Boat Crest app and it'll sort itself out. All right, that's all I got for this one. If this helped you, make sure to drop a like, maybe even subscribe if you're into this kind of content. I appreciate it.

title: This Freeze Frame Looks Like VFX — But It’s Just One Simple Cut in Premiere Pro
transcription:
This is the frozen in time effect.
Here's how to do it.
To get started, fill up a glass of water.
You need some sort of element that'll really stand out frozen in time. Now, it doesn't have to be a liquid. It could be something as simple as a deck of cards mid-shuffle.
Now, the secret to this effect lies in your camera settings. Set your shutter speed to at least 1 over 500, but the higher the better. I went with one over 2000 for this example. You're freezing motion midair, so any blur is going to ruin the illusion. So lock in that crispy detail, then fake the rest in post. Now, standing in frame, shake your hand hard enough to spill the water, but keep your body still. Then snap your head to the camera, frozen in place and deliver your line. 
This is the frozen in time effect. So, you guys want to make sure you're in a space that can afford to get wet, as this one's going to get a little messy. The key here is really just a combination of a high shutter speed and keeping your body as still as humanly possible.
Now, go ahead and fire up Premiere Pro. and while that loads, there's actually a plug-in I've been using lately that quietly changed the game. So you can now access millions of free stock assets and a powerful animation preset system, no After Effects required. Just drag and drop, right into your timeline. This is the frozen in time effect. Go to the moment you want the freeze to happen, and alt drag to duplicate your clip. On the bottom layer, right click and add a frame hold. This freezes that layer. Move ahead to the point where you're about to turn your head, make a cut on both layers and delete that middle section. title: Advantech at COMPUTEX 2025 | Unboxing MIC-743
transcription: Hello everyone. This is Elvis from Advantech. Welcome to our booth at Computex. Today, I'm excited to unveil a truly groundbreaking live demo, a pioneering solution powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor. Jetson Thor delivers up to 2,074 FP4 TFLOPS of AI performance with 128 GB of memory, making it the ultimate platform of AI-enhanced robotics, edge-based LLM, VLLM, and autonomous machines. In this demo, we are showcasing video search and summarization, a task that previously required four to eight H100 GPUs in a server environment. Now, thanks to Advantech's MIC-744 and the 743 Jetson Thor systems, VSS can run directly at the edge with dramatically reduced power and cost. The secret lies in our sensor bridge and sensor switch architecture, enabling sensor-to-compute over Ethernet using GPU Direct RDMA. This delivers ultra-low latency data transfer from sensor directly into the GPU, achieving real-time AI performance like never before. This isn't just a demo, it is a glimpse into the future of edge intelligence. Come explore how Advantech and NVIDIA making the edge AI faster, leaner, and more powerful than ever, right here at Advantech.

title: From Hope to Fear: Inside the Immigration Crackdown
transcription: The pain behind the silence. The root of the unrest. This protest in America didn't erupt overnight. It was born from years of quiet suffering. For decades, millions of undocumented immigrants worked silently. They labored in the fields, cleaned homes, and powered the economy from behind the scenes. Yet, their presence was always treated as temporary, tolerated, not accepted. Then, in early 2025, the US government launched a harsh campaign called the Immigration Dragnet. Raids began in areas densely populated by undocumented workers. Farmers, builders, cleaners, and families who had lived in the country for decades. Homes were stormed, workplaces were invaded. It wasn't just a legal crackdown. It was a message. This country is not yours. That campaign lit a fuse. It started in Los Angeles. A small group of farmworkers walked out onto the streets. Their eyes full of tears, their hands holding signs, their voices trembling with one message. We are human, not illegal. Soon it spread across the country. New York, Chicago, Houston, Sacramento, city after city saw waves of peaceful protesters. They weren't just speaking for themselves. They spoke for the ones who had been detained, the parents separated from children, the silent. The response was brutal. Police fired tear gas, national guard troops were deployed. Mainstream media painted them as threats, as outsiders. But the truth was simple. They were just asking to be treated as people. Dreams, fear, and the road ahead. What now? Now the question stands, where is this going? Some politicians call it a victory for law and order. Others see it as a new face of racial injustice. But for the people on the ground, this is not just about laws. It's about homes, families, and futures. This is a battle for belonging. Experts say, if the movement stays united, if their voices don't scatter, this won't be just a protest, it will become a movement. A movement that could reshape immigration policy and redefine what the American dream truly means. Because the real question is, is the American dream only for those with papers or also for those with calloused hands?

title: Protesters help clean up Little Tokyo museum damaged during protest
transcription: There has been so much collateral damage from the raids, the protests and the violence. For instance, LA's Little Tokyo, a historic immigrant community, has been heavily vandalized. But as eyewitness news reporter Rob Hayes shows us, the turmoil has also created an opportunity to find some common ground. Ice raids may have lit the fuse, but Ice didn't pay the price. Cars were burned, businesses were looted, and logic disappeared. Case in point, the Japanese-American National Museum. Our museum is a beacon, is a champion for social justice and civil rights. It was also one of the places hardest hit with graffiti during the protest. Museum board member Bill Fujioka says he's dumbfounded a museum built on the spot where thousands of Japanese Americans were shipped off to internment camps would be targeted by so-called immigration supporters. What's happening now is an element has come into this peaceful protest to just cause destruction, havoc and with just madness. But amid all this graffiti and damage comes redemption. This morning, a small group of people who were part of the protests the last few days showed up this morning to help clean up the mess left behind, a mess they say they don't support. Susan Chicarol and a handful of demonstrators reached out to the museum and Little Tokyo community leaders, looking to right what they say is a wrong that came from the hands of a small group of instigators. This museum is a testament to, um, when United States citizens who were Japanese-Americans were incarcerated during World War II. Nobody should be touching this building. Brian Kido runs a little Tokyo shop that's been in his family for more than 120 years. He too supports peaceful protest, but wants the demonstrators to stop randomly targeting businesses. It's really hard to to support them when we're getting beat up by them. But with more demonstrations expected, the hope is that the Little Tokyo community and its famed museum will escape more destruction. The protester cleaning crew today leaving behind this respect the museum tarp, spray paint, a language the instigators should understand. Please respect the museum because I'm cleaning it up today. In Little Tokyo, Rob Hayes, ABC 7 Eyewitness News.

title: What No One Tells You About Buying a VW Camper Van
transcription: There's an old saying that you can't polish a turd, and the same goes with camper vans. It's very easy to fall into the trap of buying a van with a funky paint job that looks great, but underneath, it could end up costing you a fortune. Firstly, make sure to check the service history. And secondly, it's always beneficial to get a mechanic to check the van over if you're not too sure. The best camper is the one that you'll use the most. Nobody wants to set off on their adventures with a van that might not get there. Although, at least if you do break down, you can still make a cuppa. The short wheel base, like we have here, versus the long wheel base is a debate that divides the camper community. It's nice to have the extra space inside that the long wheel base gives you, but if you're using it as your everyday car, the short wheel base is a much better everyday package. They maneuver better and they just about fit in a standard parking space, whereas the long wheel base will leave its boot hanging out, and that's never a good sight. There's a reason why the short wheel base drastically out sells the long wheel base. It's because it makes a much better everyday package. However, if you have another car and you're just using your camper for camping trips, the long wheel base may be worth a look. There's a good reason why the vast majority of camper vans have the traditional side kitchen, rear bed layout. It gives you good seating for four people if you swivel the seats like this, and a quick and easy to pull out bed with plenty of room for two people. However, although it works for the vast majority of people, there are other options for layouts depending on how you're going to use your van. You can have a rear lounge, but it does mean you get a smaller kitchen, or you can have a big long side kitchen with a bench on the other side, but that does mean you can only have the front traveling seats. But, if you do have only the two or maybe three seats in the front, it can limit how you use your van, especially if you're using it every day. There is no wrong layout. There's just the one that suits you best. But bear in mind, when it comes to moving the van on, the traditional side kitchen will be much easier to sell. Adding the ability to stand up in your van is something that most people would find essential. and this is usually done by a pop top. I always tell people the biggest difference they'll find with having a pop top is getting dressed in the morning. Unless you're a contortionist, the morning routine is something that's quite difficult to do when you can't stand up. On top of that, if you're intending to use your van on days where the sun might not be beaming, a bit like today, it's quite nice to be able to have a place to retire to and stretch your legs away from the weather. Just make sure when you're buying a roof for your vehicle, you buy a good quality one. Unfortunately, the boom in the camper van industry over the past few years has led to quite a few poor quality roofs hitting the market. With it being such a big part of your conversion, it's really not worth cutting corners here. Just make sure to go to a reputable company like ourselves who can show you that safety and quality are a high priority. No matter what your situation, a camper van is a big purchase. It's something you buy with your heart to fulfill our deep rooted desire for adventure. The last thing you need is for it to become a headache. But you need to use your head and make sure that you've got reassurances that your van has got a warranty. Don't let some backstreet cowboys ruin your dream. Make the right choices to ensure you can sleep soundly at night.

title: Premier League - Official App Review
transcription: For every passionate follower of English football, the official Premier League app promises to be your ultimate digital companion, bringing you every goal, stat, and story straight from the source. Its biggest strengths are its comprehensive and reliable real-time match data. You get instant live scores, detailed statistics, matchday live blogs, and up-to-the-minute league tables. It's also the official hub for Fantasy Premier League, FPL, allowing you to manage your team, make transfers, and track your points seamlessly within the app. You'll find a rich library of video highlights, exclusive news, detailed player profiles, and historical data, making it a true statistical treasure trove for fans. But for the honest truth, while the core content is fantastic, users frequently report technical glitches and bugs, particularly with the FPL section, which can sometimes freeze or fail to refresh properly. The app's overall stability and speed can sometimes be inconsistent, especially during peak match times. While it offers highlights, it does not provide live streaming of matches. You'll need separate TV or streaming subscriptions for that. And some features, like certain advanced FPL options, can sometimes feel better on the desktop website than in the app. So, is the Premier League official app a must have for fans? Absolutely. For real-time data, FPL management, and comprehensive news, it's an indispensable free tool. Just be prepared for the occasional app quirk that might make you yell at your phone. What are your thoughts on the Premier League app? Let me know below.

questions.answer: The app's biggest strengths are its comprehensive and reliable real-time match data (including live scores, stats, and live blogs) and its function as the official hub for Fantasy Premier League (FPL).

title: John Lennon and Paul McCartney almost had a Beatles reunion gig in 1976?
transcription: In April 1976, six years after the Beatles' official breakup, an unusual moment in television history nearly triggered a legendary reunion. Lorne Michaels, the newly appointed producer of Saturday Night Live, made a bold and humorous pitch during a live broadcast. Looking straight into the camera, he offered the Beatles $3,000 to reunite on the SNL stage and perform three of their classic songs. Holding up a check, Michaels jokingly added that the money could be split however they wished, even suggesting that if they felt Ringo Starr didn't deserve an equal share, they were free to divide the funds accordingly. The proposal was clearly meant as satire, but fatefully, two of the Beatles, John Lennon and Paul McCartney, were watching the show that very night. McCartney happened to be visiting Lennon at his Dakota apartment in New York City, only a short cab ride away from the NBC studio. According to various sources, including Tom Doyle's Man on the Run, the two icons laughed heartily at Michael's stunt. Lennon, amused, turned to McCartney and suggested, half-jokingly, "Should we go down there and just do it?" They were reportedly close to calling a cab, but ultimately decided against it, citing the late hour and their desire to relax. It was a near miss that fans have since romanticized as the Beatles reunion that almost happened. Although Lennon and McCartney didn't follow through, the moment lived on as a curious what if in pop culture. Later that year, George Harrison appeared on SNL's cold open. In a scripted bit, he confronted Lorne Michaels to claim the $3,000. Michaels explained deadpan that the offer was intended for all four members and that Harrison alone was only entitled to $750. Harrison, staying in character, haggled for an extra $250 if he agreed to say the famous line, "Live from New York, it's Saturday night." This whimsical series of events has become a cherished anecdote among Beatles fans, capturing a moment when a spontaneous, lighthearted invitation nearly brought together two of the world's most influential musicians. It stands as a testament to the Beatles' enduring presence in the public imagination and how even the most casual of gestures can ripple through music history.

You have to go through different obstacles to move ahead and it's much harder than it looks. Apart from the first one, all the other obstacles shuffle around every time you hit the retry. It's a fun but challenging game and I dare you to score just five points on this game. My high score is six. Next up, Hit the Island. It was the first game specifically designed for interacting with the dynamic island. Now, it's also available on the Apple Watch. You have to hit the dynamic island at the top to score points and also save the ball from dropping. You can control the bottom bar via touch or using the scroll wheel. The speed of the ball increases as the game progresses. It's a really fun game. In this 3D game, you play as Dare the monkey. The aim in the game is to collect as many banana coins as you can while avoiding all the obstacles in the way like wooden spikes, big birds, crates, etc. You can control the jump of the monkey through both the touch screen and the crown button. The all-time high score is displayed at the bottom. Mine is 40. Try to beat it. This one is for the bowling fans. The Vegas bowling light is a fun little game. It features a bowling lane with simple graphics, but the gameplay is really fun. Use the scroll wheel to give the ball rotation and just pull back on the screen and release. It also tracks your score just like a real bowling lane and you can compete with in-game characters. Last but not the least, Snake Watch. The classic snake game on Apple Watch. In it, you have to eat as much as you can to grow as large as you can. But beware, if you try to eat any other snake, it's game over. Instead, you can trap them and if they try to eat you, they'll become your food. So, those were seven of the coolest fun games that you can play on your Apple Watch. Let me know in the comments if you have tried any of these and don't forget to like the video, subscribe for Weholic and I'll see you in the next one.

Inside the tower, secret rooms and military bunkers tell stories of war and resistance. Gustav Eiffel had his own private apartment at the top, a sanctuary in the sky away from the city's chaos. Now, let's descend. Paris is not just beautiful, it's layered. Beneath the cobblestone streets lies a second city, hidden passages, World War II bunkers, secret metro stations, some still in use, others abandoned and lost to time. Urban explorers whisper of the Phantom metro lines and government tunnels that link key institutions beneath the surface. And deeper still lie the catacombs. Over 6 million souls rest beneath Paris, skeletons arranged in eerie patterns, lining the walls of ancient limestone quarries. This labyrinth stretches for over 200 miles, most of it off limits, uncharted, and forbidden. But the curious always find a way. There are tales of secret cinemas, illegal parties, even entire art galleries hidden in the underworld. Some say there are chambers no one has entered in centuries. Paris reveals herself only to those who look closely. So next time you stroll by the Sen or gaze at the Eiffel Tower, ask yourself what lies beneath.

title: Paris Fire Chief emphasizes natural gas, carbon monoxide safety after 2 emergencies
transcription: One city's fire department is sharing safety reminders after a pair of natural gas and carbon monoxide emergencies in the same day. Paris fire officials say it all started when customers at a glass shop on Lakeside Terrace Drive reported smelling natural gas. Staff then checked the gas meter and found a leak. Later that day, officials say a car crashed into a home near Blackburn and Van Streets. A natural gas line was damaged there. The driver contacted Ameren and fire crews secured the area. Blackburn Street was shut down while repairs were made. Fire officials say all homes should have one of these, a carbon monoxide detector within 15 feet of every sleeping area. Gas leaks are not always noticeable by smell, making this safety precaution even more crucial.

questions.answer: The two emergencies were a natural gas leak at a glass shop and a car crashing into a home, which damaged a natural gas line.

title: Nicole Kidman Breaks Silence on Life After Divorce from Keith Urban
transcription: Nicole Kidman just broke her silence, and what she said hits deep. The Oscar-winning actress is opening up like never before, revealing the emotional truth behind her recent split from Keith Urban, and how she's finally taking control of her life's direction. In a new interview with Vogue, recorded just before filing for divorce, Nicole shared words that now sound almost prophetic. Quote, How many times do you have to be taught, she said, that you think you know where your life is going and then it isn't going in that direction. Unquote. At the time, no one knew what was coming, but just a few weeks later, the world found out that Nicole had officially filed to end her 19-year marriage to country star Keith Urban. Now, fans are reading that quote in a whole new light. Nicole wasn't just reflecting, she was preparing herself for change, for peace, and for freedom. During the interview, she talked about what it means to protect her peace and to choose herself, even when it's hard. She recalled skipping the 2024 Venice Film Festival where she was supposed to accept a best actress award following the heartbreaking loss of her mother, Janelle Kidman. Quote, Everyone was saying, you've got to still go and accept the award, she shared. And I just sat for a minute and said, no, I can't. I don't and I won't. Unquote. That moment said it all. Nicole was done living for what others expected. She was finally standing up for herself, saying no when she needed to, and yes to her own healing. It's a powerful message, especially coming from someone who's lived so much of her life in the public eye. After nearly two decades of marriage, raising two daughters, and balancing massive careers, Nicole's words remind us that even icons have to stop, breathe, and choose peace. As she steps into this new chapter, Nicole Kidman isn't just turning the page, she's rewriting the story on her own terms. What do you think about Nicole's decision to prioritize her peace and protect her energy? Let us know in the comments, and don't forget to like and subscribe for more celebrity updates and deep dives into Hollywood's biggest stories.

title: Mystro Driver App Review: Does It Really Worth It Or Not?
transcription: Ever tried juggling Uber, Lyft, and DoorDash all at once, only to feel like you need eight arms and a crystal ball? That's exactly why I downloaded the Maestro Driver app, and after weeks of testing, here's the real story. Maestro's biggest selling point is automation. It automatically switches between Uber and Lyft based on the filters you set, like trip distance, passenger rating or surge pricing. That means no more fumbling between apps while driving, and yes, it actually makes multitasking safer. For me, it cut down the stress of choosing rides and helped me grab better paying trips without staring at my phone. The app also tracks earnings across platforms, which is huge for seeing if the grind is actually worth it. I loved opening one screen and knowing instantly what my day added up to. On the flip side, it's not perfect. The subscription fee feels steep if you're only driving part-time. And sometimes the app lags or misses a request during busy hours. Also, it currently supports only certain markets, so availability can be hit or miss. Still, for full-time gig drivers, Maestro can feel like having a digital co-pilot. If you want to maximize rides and reduce the chaos of app switching, it's worth considering. Just know you're paying for convenience, not magic.

title: How To Enable Hearing Aid Features On AirPods Pro 3 – Live Listen & Boost
transcription: AirPods Pro 3, released in September 2024, can function as over-the-counter hearing aids for mild to moderate hearing loss. First, pair them as hearing aids in iOS settings. Go to settings, accessibility, hearing devices. Select your AirPods Pro 3 and tap use as hearing aid. This activates FDA compliant amplification with adjustable settings for each ear. Two key features enhance hearing, Live listen and boost, which is integrated into adaptive audio. These features require a compatible iOS device, iPhone 12 or later, running iOS 17 or higher. Live listen turns your iPhone into a remote microphone, streaming audio directly to your AirPods Pro 3. To enable it, open control center by swiping down from the top right corner of your screen. Tap the ear icon, then toggle live listen on. Keep the iPhone near the sound source for best results. Adaptive audio dynamically adjusts amplification, boosting softer sounds such as conversations in noisy environments. To enable it, go to settings on your iPhone. Navigate to accessibility, then hearing devices. Select adaptive audio to activate the feature. These features combined make the AirPods Pro 3 a versatile solution for improving hearing in various situations.

transcription: Far away from the noise of the city, in the stillness of the countryside, lives a young woman whose life looks calm from the outside. But inside, her world is fragile, filled with feelings she cannot explain. At times she is tender, loving, and full of warmth. Yet suddenly, her emotions shift into silence, fear, and confusion. Her husband works hard, trying to hold their family together, but he cannot understand the storms inside her heart. She walks through the forest, searching for peace, yet the shadows of her mind follow everywhere she goes. The beauty of nature surrounds her, but even in sunlight, she feels trapped in a darker world within herself. title: Pre Premier League Era
transcription: The pre-Premier League era. Before the Premier League existed, top-flight English football was organized through the Football League, founded in 1888. For over a century, it was the undisputed pinnacle of English club football. It featured multiple divisions, a structured promotion and relegation system, and iconic rivalries. But despite the passion, the league never commanded the massive global TV revenue or corporate sponsorship deals that would come decades later. Attending a match was a community affair. Working class fans packed terraces shoulder to shoulder, singing anthems unique to their towns and waving handmade banners. Local pride, not profit, was the lifeblood of football. Facilities were basic, ticket prices were low, and players often lived modest lives, sometimes holding second jobs. But change was coming. By the late 1980s and early 1990s, English football faced existential challenges. The Heysel Stadium disaster, 1985, in which 39 people died due to crowd violence at a European Cup final, led to a ban on English clubs in European competition.

title: 45,000 homes in Berlin without power after politically motivated attack by 'left-wing extremists'
transcription: Around 45,000 households were left without electricity in southwest Berlin after high-voltage power lines were damaged by a fire, which authorities have described as a politically motivated attack by far-left extremists. With power restored in some areas, around 35,000 households will remain affected until Thursday, authorities have said, as poor weather conditions continue to hamper repair operations. Police patrols were heavy and the military has set up shelters for those whose homes are already too cold to stay in. Last September, an attack on an electricity pylon in Berlin left around 50,000 homes without power, taking around 60 hours to be restored.

title: Thousands fill London streets for "Unite the Kingdom" rally
transcription: over the weekend and estimated 110,000 people took to the London streets in what's believed to be the largest anti-immigration protest in British history. You see the images on your screen here. Organers called it a Unite the Kingdom rally. A minute of silence was also held for conservative activist Charlie Kirk during the event. The march was organized by the far right anti-immigration activist Tommy Robinson. It was billed as a celebration of free speech. And close by there was a much smaller counter protest organized by anti-racism activists. At one point, right-wing marchers clashed with the group and began throwing things at them and pushing police. London's metropolitan police said a number of its officers were assaulted by the right-wing demonstrators and the crowds grew so large that some surrounding areas had to be closed off for safety. Meanwhile, tomorrow, President Donald Trump will be heading there to the UK. Trump is set to meet with King Charles and Prime Minister Keir Starmer.

transcription: Lewis Hamilton has never hidden his admiration for Brazil. Since his first races at Interlagos, the seven-time world champion has developed a deep connection with the country and with the legendary figure of Ayrton Senna, his greatest idol. In several interviews, the driver speaks with emotion about the culture, the people, and the energy he feels every time he's in Brazilian territory. I've always loved Brazil. When I first started going there, I remember feeling this intensity in my chest because it was the first time I'd been so close to Ayrton. I mean, he was right there. He's buried there, and I could feel his presence. In my early years, I was competing against a Brazilian, so I wasn't exactly the most loved at that time, but each year I went back, I really wanted to pay tribute to their culture, to Ayrton, to his family, and to what they mean to the country. And then I had this incredible opportunity to drive his car in Brazil. And, wow. I think it's a place where maybe I'll live one day. I really love Brazil. I think it's a bit like when I go to Mexico. When you go to certain places, they're so rich in culture. And when you go to Brazil, the depth of that culture is something you feel in every person you meet. It's such a very, very diverse country. It has an incredible history regarding the number of black people who were taken there from Africa. I think around 12 million Africans were brought to Brazil. And you know, there's so much passion and so much pride in that country. I think, traveling around the world, I've never found another country or nationality with people so proud of where they come from. title: Halloween The Game Gameplay Trailer | TGS 2025
transcription: Death comes to Haddenfield in Halloween the game, a tribute to the John Carpenter classic. The team at Illfonic invites players to an asymmetrical horror sandbox where you can play as a civilian survivor or Michael Myers himself. In each game, it's up to you as survivors to save these hapless townsfolk or to hunt them down as Michael Myers. He possesses unique abilities like shape jump, allowing him to move around the map unseen and pop out where you'd least expect it. Playing as a civilian, it's up to you to lead townsfolk to safety, find a phone, and call the police for help. Civilians can also scavenge for gear and weapons to help them survive when they inevitably cross paths with the unstoppable Michael Myers. Become the boogeyman or protect his victims when Halloween the game launches on September 8th, 2026.

title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G - OFFICIAL HANDS-ON VIDEO! (IcyBlue Colour).
transcription: We've just got an exclusive early hands-on look at the upcoming Samsung Galaxy A57 5G. And this particular unit is in the brand new Icy Blue color. Thanks to a Twitter tipster called Early Tech, we already have a first glimpse at the phone before its official announcement. As you can see, the Icy Blue finish looks very clean and premium, and the back panel follows the minimal design language that Samsung has been using in its recent smartphones. The phone features a triple camera setup aligned vertically, giving it a simple yet modern look. From the sides, the device appears quite slim with flat edges, which makes it look more modern and comfortable to hold. Let's watch the complete hands-on video. and new awesome colors. According to a claim shared by WinFuture's Roland Quandt on Blue Sky, the Galaxy A57 is reported to launch in five stylish shades: charcoal, icy blue, gray, lilac, and navy. While the Galaxy A37 may arrive in white, charcoal, gray-green, lavender, and navy. All part of Samsung's signature Awesome color theme. In terms of performance, earlier leaks suggest the Galaxy A57 will feature the Exynos 1680 chipset and an OLED display sourced from BOE. While the Galaxy A37 is likely to run on the Exynos 1480 processor with a large 5,000mAh battery. Both devices are also said to support 45-watt fast charging and include IP68 water and dust resistance, premium features in the mid-range category.

questions.question: According to the video, what are the five reported color options for the Samsung Galaxy A57?
questions.answer: The five stylish shades reported for the Galaxy A57 are Charcoal, Icy Blue, Gray, Lilac, and Navy.
